1440: Amar, zakkaa annet ribbi yose, demillin dehay gadya zeera, vedimoy, seliku legabbe kurseyay demalka kaddisha, vedanu dina, utelesar bene nasha azmin kudesha berich hu lemalach hammavt beginach, veha esrin uteren shenin osifu lach, ad detolif orayyta, lehay gadya shelema, chaviva kamme kudesha berich hu.

Kamu ribbi elazar vechavrayyay, vela shavku levar nash lemekam beveta, miyyad chamu hahu ammuda deeshsha desalik, veribbi yose patach enoy. vehahu yannuka davik pumeh befumeh. amar ribbi elazar, zakkaa chulakana dachamena techiyyayt hammetim, ena beena. kerivu legabbeh, vahava hahu yannuka naim, kema degava mehay alma, amru zakkaa chulakach ribbi yose, uvarich rachamana dearchish lach nisa, al gaya uvichyay divnach, uvemilloy, dehachi dachik bemillin shepirin litra shemaya, bemilloy uvedimoy osifu lach chayyin.

Netaluhu lehahu yannuka, uneshakuhu uvachu immeh mechedva saggi. veafkuhu leveta achara, veattearu aleh, vela odu leh miyyad, ella levatar hachi. chadu tamman telata yomin, vechadishu bahade hahu ribbi yose, kama chiddushin beorayyta.

Amar lon ribbi yose, chavrayyay, la ityehivat li reshu legallaa mehahu dachamena behahu alma, ella levatar teresar shenin. aval telat mea veshittin vachamesh dimin, deoshid beri, alu bechushebana kamme malka kaddisha, veomena lechu chavrayyay, divshaata defatach behahu pesuka, vegaa beinnun millin, izdaazau telat mea alfe safsale dahavo bimtivta dirkia, vechullehu kayyme kammeh demalka kaddisha, uvau rachame alay, vearvu li. vekudesha berich hu itmele rachamin alay.

Veshappir kammeh, innun millin, vehech masar nafsheh alay. vechad appotropposa hava kammeh, vekaamar, mare dealma, ha ketiv (Tehillim 8:3) mippi ollim veyonkim yissadta oz lemaan tzorrecha lehashebit oyev umitnakkem. yehe raava kammach, zechu deorayyta, uzechu dehahu ravya, deka masar nafsheh al avuha detechus aleh, veyishteziv.

Utelesar bene nasha azmin leh techotay, veirvona yahav leh, middina takkifa da. keden kara kudesha berich hu lemalach hammavt, ufakid leh alay, deletuv levatar esrin uteren shenin, deha lav irvona kammeh, ella lituv lidoy, mashkonin dahavo bidoy, hasheta chavrayyay, begin dechama kudesha berich hu deattun zakkae keshot, itrechish nisa leenayychu.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Shmuel 1 2:6) Adonai memit umechayye morid sheol vayyaal. hay kera it leistakkela beh, vechi Adonai memit, veha shema da sama dechayyin ihu lecholla. umilla da demota, la sharya beh, uvechol atar shema da yahiv chayyin lechol alma, mahu Adonai memit, chashvin bene nasha deihu katil lechol bene nasha. ella Adonai memit vadday deihu aleh, la yachlin kol mekatregin dealma lenazka leh, beshaata deistalik minneh, miyyad kol mekatregin yachlin leh, umit bar nash. lav hachi.

Ella Adonai memit, leman memit. lehahu meshichu desitra achara bisha. kevan dimshichu desitra bisha, chame leh leziv yekareh dekudesha berich hu, miyyad mit. velet leh kiuma afillu riga chada. kevan dehahu meshichu distar achara mit veitavar min alma, miyyad mechayye. leman mechayye. lehahu meshichu deruach kudsha, deate missitra dikdushsha, mechayye leh, veokim leh bekiyyuma shelim. kolla avid kudesha berich hu bezimna chada. uma deamar morid sheol vayyaal. morid lehahu ruach kaddisha lishol, veavid leh tamman tevila, leittedakkaa, umiyyad salik leh, (lishol, leittedna tamman, umiyyad salik leh veavid leh tamman tevila) veal laatar deitzterich began eden.

Vaana, chavrayyay, behahiv shaata deistelakna mealma, rucha dili istellak vedamach miyyad, ad shaata zeera deachyay li kudesha berich hu, vegufa hava mit. beshaata defatach beri beinnun millin, keden parcha nishmateh (nusach acher nishmati), veiaraat benishmeta dili, dehava salleka miggo dachyu umiggo tevila, vealat baatar dealat, vetamman ittedan dinaha, veityeyhivu li esrin uteren shenin dechayyin, begin dimin
1441: Umillin divri, mikkan ulehala, it li leishtaddela bema dachamena, deha let li leishtaddela bemillin dehay alma. kevan dachamena ma dachamena, uvae kudesha berich hu dela yitavid veyitneshe minnay kelum.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 118:18) yassor yisseranni yah vegomer, david malka amar da, al kol ma (sefer acher deabar) deavad behay alma, veamar al avtachuta dehava leh behahu alma. al kol ma deabar behay alma, dirdifu leh, vahava (leh) arik beara nucheraa, beara demoav, uveara diflishtae, umikkullehu sheziv leh kudesha berich hu, vela shavik leh lemota, veamar al avtachuta dehahu alma.

Amar david, i hacha chavna legabbe kudesha berich hu, hacha alkena, vekabbilna onsha dili, veadke li mikkol ma dechavna, vela shavik onsha dili lehahu alma, batar mita. vadday yassor yisseranni yah, behay alma, begin lenakkaa li. velammavt lo netanani, behahu alma, lenatla nikmata minnay, vaana, ha kudesha berich hu, anke li zimna chada behay alma, mikkan vehala itzterichna dela ehe bechissufa bealma deate.

Patach hahu yannuka bereh veamar, (Bamidbar 27:3) avinu met bammidbar vehu lo haya betoch haeda vegomer. avinu, ha taama leella, arich milla umashich lah, i chasidin kaddishin, kama meshichu detzaara bemikre avinu. let tzaara, velet keeva derucha venafsha, ella kad karan hachi, avinu, bicheva millibba. met vammidbar, vechi acharanin la mitu bemadbera, dehacha rashim leh, veamar deihu met bammidbar, veha elef veribbevan mitu bemadbera.

Ella kama bene nasha artilain al da, minnehon amre dehu mekoshesh etzim hava, dichtiv ki vecheto met. uminnehon amre hachi, uminnehon amre hachi, vaana hachi olifna, yoma deabba nafal beve mareh, olfe li da. vaana chamena ma dachamena, defakid li abba dela legallaa. ella kama vechamma havo demitu bemadbera, vela al chova dekorach, vela al chova dimraglim, kad itgezar gezera, (sefer acher velo al chova deegla deavdu vechulei) ella kodem (sefer acher demitu al chova dekorach, al chova dameragelaym, kad itgezar gezera, vekodem) mattan tora, uvatar egla deavdu, innun mattaay alma, veinnun deitmeshachu abbatrayyhu.

Aval taana detainu inun benatin, demit vammidbar, ihu, vahava tzelafchad rav leve yosef, umiggo dela yada archoy deorayyta kaddeka yaut, la hava nasi. vehu hava dela natar pumeh umilloy lokovleh demoshe, vealeh ketiv, (Bamidbar 21:6) vayyamat am rav miyisrael. gevar dela yada orayyta, (sefer acher lav rav beorayyta) veihu rav mishshepacha. rav dezara deyosef, mibbenoy dimnashe. uvegin dechav bammidbar bemillula legabbe moshe, chashivu demoshe antir devavu. uvegin kach kerivu lekammeh demoshe, veelazar, vechol hanesiin, vechol reshshe avahan, vela mallilu im moshe ella lekammayyhu, begin dekanniu kina minneh.

Mikkan, man dechayish min dayyana, yekarev acharanin, veyisge beguverin bahade hahu dayyayna, begin deyishmeun dina minneh, veyidchal minnayyhu, vela yehe dan ella kaddeka yaut, vei la, yidche leh min dina. veinnun la yadu deha (Bamidbar 12:3) moshe anav meod mikkol haadam asher al pene haadama. vela yadu demoshe lav hachi.

Kevan dechama moshe kach, amar chamena dechol kenufeya deguverin ravrevin miyisrael, vechol reshe avahan vechol nesie kenishta, alay kerivu. miyyad itperash moshe min dina, hada hu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 27:5) vayyakrev moshe et mishpatan lifne Adonai. (amar moshe da lo itchaze ledina) anvatanuta demoshe, akriv et mishpatan lifne Adonai. dayyaynin acharanin, archa da la natle, deaf al gav dichnufeya saggi alehon. innun dayyne ikrun azze panim, let behu meanvatanuta demoshe kelal. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe. chadu ribbi elazar vechavrayyay.

Amar hahu yannuka, ahadarna lemillin kadmain. avinu met bammidbar avinu hay taama dame, lennachash talyay al kedaleh, umashich zanbeh befumeh, betama, dehahu deitmeshach aleh leella. met bammidbar, bemillula defumeh. itbehil hahu yannuka bivhilu, veatkif bekudela daavoy, uvacha veamar, tzelafchad da bemillula mit, veant abba bemillula ahadrat lealma da. ahdar avoy venashik
1442: Leh, vegafif leh. bachu ribbi elazar, vechavrayyay kullehu, vaavoy bacha bahadayyhu, netaluhu kullehu uneshakuhu befumoy, al resheh, veal enoy, vaavu hava bache bahadeh.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, beri, hoil veamrat milla da, mahu ki vecheto met. amar hahu yannuka, abba, abba, bechad milla saggi lon, vecheto dehahu (sefer acher kevan dehahu) nachash decharich biznaveh leella, mashich taama vecheto, may vecheto. vecheto dehahu nachash. (velo bechet achara) umay ihu. millula defumeh, ki vecheto met, taama dehahu meshichu dehahu nachash dekaruch biznaveh, vecheto vadday.

Natleh ribbi elazar betukepeh, ben derooy, uvachu kullehu chavrayyay. amar lon, rabbanan, shevoku li bahade abba, dead kean la ityayshva ruchi (sefer acher rucheh). amar ribbi elazar leribbi yose, emma kama yomin veshanin lehay yannuka. amar lon, chavrayyay, bematu minnayychu la tivun da, deha ad la matu aloy chamesh shenin.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, chas veshalom, deha beena tava ashgachna beh. uma deamrat chamesh shenin, innun chamesh shenin (Bereshit 45:6) asher en charish vekatzir. dela tiktzor leh lealmin. amar ribbi elazar leribbi abba, netiv hacha ad 7 yomin, begin deityayshsheva beta. deha kol shiva yomin denishmeta nafkat min gufa, azlat artilaa. vehasheta deahadarat, ad kaan la ityayshshevat beduchetaha, ad shiva yomin.

Amar ribbi abba, ketiv (Devarim 15:11) patoach tiftach et yadcha leachicha laaniyyecha uleevyoncha, kera da, ha tanenan leh, dela yishbok bar nash anya dileh, veyahiv leachara. ha ribbi yose chamuch beve mareh, nezil venigmol chesed immeh. uvatar denehdar, neul behay. veha kol zimna denehach venehdar bearcha da, necheme techiyyayt hammetim. amar ribbi elazar vadday hachi hu, neshakuhu lehahu yannuka, berchuhu veazlu.

Amar ribbi abba, tavavhna al dardeke dedara da, kama takkifa chelayyhu, veinnun tinarin ravrevin ramin. amar ribbi elazar, zakkaa chulakeh deabba, mareh dedara da. deha beyomoy, bae kudesha berich hu leatkkena, teren metivtin dileh, ulemebad lon yishshuva ravreva veillaa kaddeka yaut. deha la yehe kedara da, ad deyete malka meshicha. azlu.

Ad dahavo azle, amar ribbi abba, ha tanenan, al chad sere millin nigin atyayn al bene nasha. veillen innun: al avoda zara. veal killelat hashshem. veal giluy arayot. veal geneva. veal lashon hara. veal edut shaker. veal dayyayna dimkalkel yat dina. veal shevuat shav. veal deal bitchuma dechavreh. veal dimchashshev machashavin bishin. veal dimshalleach medanim ben achim. veit deamre, af al ena bisha. vechullehu tanenan bematnita.

Avoda zara minnayin. dichtiv, (Shemot 32:25) vayyar moshe et haam ki farua hu ki ferao aharon. may ki farua hu. dealku betzaraat. ketiv hacha ki farua hu, uchetiv hatam, (Vayikra 13:45) vehatztzarua asher bo hannega begadav yihyu ferumim verosho yihye farua. veal killelat hashshem, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 17:46) hayyom hazze yesaggercha Adonai beyadi, uchetiv, (Vayikra 13:5) vehisgiro hakkohen.

Amar ribbi abba, milla da la ityayshva, veitzterich leayyeyna beh. amar ribbi elazar, hachi hu vadday, pelishti da kariv leyichusa dedavid hava, uverah dearpa hava, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 17) mimaarchot pelishtim, al tikre mimaarchot, ella mimmearot pelishtim, deshavyuha leimmeh kimarta da. vechevan dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 17:43) vaykallel happelishti et david belohav, istakkal beh david beena bisha. uvechol atar dehava mistakkel beena bisha, kol zine tzaraat itmashshechan meeneh dedavid. vehachi hava beyoav, kevan deistakkal beh david beena bisha, ma ketiv, (Shmuel 2 3:29) velo yikkaret mibbet yoav zav umetzora vegomer.

Vehacha beplishti da, kevan shekkilel et hashem, istakkal beh beena bisha, vechama bemitzcheh deitztera. miyyad (Shmuel 1 17:49) vattitba haeven bemitzcho, veitdabbekat hatzaraat bemitzcho. vecholla hava ishtakaat ena bisha detzaraat bemitzcho, veishtekaat avna mammash bemitzcho, vadday metzora hava.
1443: Devilam, ena dileh, hava behippucha meena dedavid ena dedavid hava merukkama mikkol zine gavvnin, la hava ena bealma shappira lemechoze, keena dedavid. kol gavvnin dealma menatztzan beh, vecholla birchimu leman dedachil chataa, dichtiv, (Tehillim 119:74) yereecha yiruni veyismachu. chaddan kad chaman li. vechol innun chayyayvin dachalin mikameh.
Aval enoy devilam chayyayva, ena bisha becholla, bechol atar dehava mistakkol, keshalhova shatze leh. deha let ena bisha bealma, keena dehahu rasha, deihu behippucha meenoy dedavid.

Al giluy arayot, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:16) vesippach Adonai kadkod benot tziyyon. uchetiv (Vayikra 14:56) velaset velassappachat. al haggeneva, dichtiv, (Zecharya Adonai:4) hotzetiha neum Adonai tzevaot uvaa el bet haggannav vegomer vechillattu veet etzav veet avanav. man hu milla dimchalle etzim vaavanim. da tzaraat. dichtiv, (Vayikra 14:45) venatatz et habbayit et avanav veet etzav.

Al lashon hara, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:1) vattedabber miryam veaharon bemoshe vegomer, uchetiv (Bamidbar 12:10) vayyifen aharon el miryam vehinne metzoraat. al edut sheker, begin desahidu yisrael sheker, veamru (Shemot 32:4) elle elohecha yisrael, bekal takkif, dichtiv (Shemot 32:17) kol milchama bammachane. begin da, (Bamidbar Adonai:2) vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vegomer.

Al dayyayn dimkalkel dina, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu Adonai:24) keechol kash leshon esh vachashash vegomer ufircham kaavak yaale vegomer, may taama. ki maasu et torat Adonai tzevaot. veen pircham, ella tzaraat. dichtiv, (Vayikra 13:12) veim paroach tifrach hatztzaraat. al deal bitchuma dechavreh minnayin. meuziyyahu. deal bitchuma dichhuna. dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 2 26:19) vehatztzaraat zarcha vemitzcho. veal dimshalleach medanim ben achim. dichtiv, (Bereshit 12:17) vaynagga Adonai et paro, deihu shallach medanim ben avraham vesara. veal ena bisha, kema deittemar. vechullehu havo beh behahu rasha devilam.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, petora asher al hannahar. may al hannahar. deyahav ena bisha, al hahu nahar, dekayyeyma behu beyisrael. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:12) hinni note eleha kenahar shalom. vehu ata behahu petora, veigre behu.

Amar ribbi abba, kol hane millin havo vadday bevilam. aval giluy arayot minnayin, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 31:16) hen henna hayu livne yisrael bidvar bilam limsar maal baAdonai vegomer. ha hacha avoda zara ugeluy arayot. sahaduta deshikra, dichtiv veyodea daat elyon, vedaat behemto la hava yada. kilkel yat dina, dichtiv lecha iatzcha. deha bedina kayyeyma, veyahav eta bisha leavasha, vesate min dina, veamlich bishin alayyhu.

Al bitchuma delav dileh, dichtiv vaaal par vaayil bammizbeach, uchetiv et shivat hammizbechot arachti. meshalleach medanim ben achim, ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim. lashon hara, la hava bealma kegineh. killelat hashshem, dichtiv veanochi ikkare ko. vechullehu havo beh. ena bisha kema deitmar. vecholla al hahu nahar deyisrael, yahav enoy leitgara beh. eretz bene ammo, vechi la yedana deeretz bene amo hi. ella raza da, dechol bene ammo mitdabbekan beh veha ittemar. (chaser, veayyen besof hassefer siman yod)

(Bamidbar 22:2) vayyar balak ben tzippor vegomer. ribbi yose patach, (Mishlei 23:6) al tilcham et lechem ra ayin vegomer. da bilam, devarich lehu leyisrael. veal titav lematammotav, da balak, dekudesha berich hu la itree leinnun illavavn deatkin kammeh.

Ta chaze, beshaata dechama balak deha sichon veog itketalu, veitnesivat arahon, chama ma chama, deihu amar vayyar. ella chama bechachmeta dileh, deihu, vachamishsha illae demidyan, veimmeh, naflin bida deyisrael. chama, vela yada, veal da akdim levilam, decheleh befumeh, kegavvna deyisrael dechelehon befumehon.

Vaafillu bilam taiv hava yattir mibbalak. vehahi yedia deihu hava yada, belelya hava yada, begin deinnun kitrin tattain vachamare, la shechichu ella bemishmara rishona delelya, veal da hava leh atana, dehay gisa, leitchabbera
1444: Vei tema, ha ketiv vayyavo elohim el bilam layla. hachi hu vadday, veokimna hahu memana dimmana alayyhu, vehu hava ate lokovleh. kegavvna da (Bereshit 31:24) vayyavo elohim el lavan haarami vegomer. vecholla chad milla. begin da ihu amar leravreve balak linu fo hallayla.

Kevan dehava ate hahu memana, bilam hava ate legabbe ataneh, vaavad ovadeh, veamar mille, ucheden atna odaa leh. veihu achze ovada lemishre aloy hahu rucha. umay achze. hu hava yada dachamare shatan vesharan bekadmita delelya, keden achze ovada, vekaim laataneh baatar metatkkan, veavid ovadoy vesidder milloy. ucheden hava ate man deate, veoda leh al yeda dehahi aton.

Kevan delelya chad amar leh lo telech immahem, may tama tav tinyaynut lehay. ella innun birshuta dilella kayyme, veha tanenan, baderech sheadam rotze lalechet bah molichin vechulei. bekadmita ketiv, lo telech immahem. kevan dechama kudesha berich hu, diruta hu lemehach. amar leh kum lech ittam veach et haddavar vegomer. ma avad bilam kol hahu lelya hava mehareher veamar uma an hu yekara dili, i bekitura achara itkattarna. ashgach kol hahu lelya becharshoy, vela ashkach sitra, diyhe hu birshuteh, ella missitra daataneh.

Vehayeynu deamar ribbi yitzchak amar ribbi yehuda, beillen kitrin tattain it yemina veit semala. missitra dimina chamare, kema deokimna. umissitra dismale atane vetana, asra innun limina, veasra lismala. veda hu deamar ribbi yose, yosef kad itperash meavoy, yada bechachmeta dilella, beraza dechitrin kadishin illain. kevan dehava bemitzrayim, olif behahi chachmeta dilhon, beinnun kitrin tattain, hech achidan innun dimina, veinnun dismala. asra dimina vaasra dismala chamare vaatane. uvegin kach ramaz laavoy mimma deolif tamman, dichtiv (Bereshit 45:23) uleaviv shalach kezot asara chamorim vegomer.

Amar ribbi yose, innun dimina kelilan kullehu bechad, deikre chamor. vehay hu hahu chamor, dichtiv, (Devarim 22:10) lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav. vehay hu chamor, dezammin malka meshicha lemishlat aleh, kema deokimna. veinnun dismala, kelilan kullehu bechad deikre aton, deha missitraha nafik iro, kitruga dedardeke, kema deokimna. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Zecharya 9:9) ani verochev al chamor veal ayir ben atonot, atanat chaser, asra dichlilan kechad.

Veda hu deamar rabbi shimon, may dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:11) osri laggefen iro. osri laggefen, zammin kudesha berich hu lekashshera beginehon deyisrael deikrun gefen. iro. deihu kattegora dilhon, uvegin deikrun sorek, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:21) veanochi netatich sorek. beni atono, hahu denafik missitra dehay aton.

Vehane 10 mimina, vey missemala, veitkelilan behane tere, kolla innun mishtachche bekesem. veit asra acharanin dimina veasra dismala, demishtachche benachash. veal da ketiv, ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael. may tama, begin ki Adonai elohav immo. missitra denachash, nafak shor, missitra dekesem, nafak chamor. veda hu shor vachamor, veal da bilam, kevan deyada deitkeshar birshuta achara, veamar leh ach et haddavar vegomer, avish leh, veamar, uma an hi yekara dili. miyyad istakkal becharshoy, vela ashkach diyhe birshuteh, ella hay aton.

Miyad (Bamidbar 22:21) vayyakam bilam babboker vayachavosh et atono lemebad reuteh bah, ureuta devalak. veal da vayyichar af elohim ki holech hu. hu dayyka, deappik garmeh mershuteh, mimma deamar leh veach et haddavar vegomer. ta chaze dehachi hu, deha bekadmita yahav leh reshuta, veamar kum lech ittam, hasheta dehava azil, amay vayyichar af elohim. ella begin deholech hu, hu birshuteh dileh, lenafka mehahu deamar leh veach et haddavar.
1445: Rasha, at metakken umezarez zayynach lenafka min reshuti, chayyecha ant vaatanach birshuti tehevon. miyyad vayyityatztzev malach Adonai. may vayyityatztzev. amar ribbi abba, nafak vekaim beumenuta achara, meumanuta dileh, dehay malacha derachame hava. vehayeynu deamar ribbi shimon, chayyayvayya mehappeche rachame ledina. lesatan lo, deha la umanuta dileh hava.

Amar ribbi elazar, la shanne malacha, vela nafak meumanuta dileh, ella begin dehava hay malacha missitra derachame, vekaim lakovleh, satir chachmeta dileh, vekilkel reuteh. hada hu dichtiv lesatan lo. lo hava satan, veishtechach satan, aval leachara la hava satan.

Tana, amar rabbi shimon, kama chakkim hava bilam becharshoy, al kol bene alma, deha beshaata deashgach, leashkecha eta lenafka mershuteh dekudesha berich hu, mehahi milla dichtiv, veach et haddavar vegomer. istakkal becharshoy, vela ashchach bar hahi aton, ma ketiv, vayachavosh et atono, atin lah bechol charshin, uvechol kesamin dehava yada, veail bah, veachlil lah mikkullehu, begin lemelat lehu leyisrael. miyyad vayyichar af elohim ki holech hu. hu dayyka kema deittemar. ma avad kudesha berich hu, akdim lemalacha derachame. lekayyeyma lokovleh, veyastir charashoy vekismoy.

Veta chaze, dead hasheta la ketiv Adonai vela itchaze bekismoy vecharshoy. veha ukemuha. vehasheta kevan deatkin ataneh, vezerza betikkune charashoy, besitra dedina lemelat leyisrael, akdim kudesha berich hu lemalacha derachame lokovleh, uvishma derachame, begin listor chachmeta dileh, uleastaa laataneh mehahu archa, kema dichtiv, vattet haaton min hadderech. min hadderech dayyka. veal da la ketiv vayyityatztzev malach haelohim, vayyaamod malach haelohim, ella malach Adonai derachame.

Amar kudesha berich hu, rasha, at atanat laatanach becharshach, bechamma sitre dedine lokovel banay. ana abar teunach, veyehafech mearcha da, miyyad akdim malacha derachame lesatan lo. lo dayyka. kema deittemar.

(Bamidbar 22:23) vattere haaton et malach Adonai vegomer. amar ribbi yitzchak, vechi amay chamat hi, uvilam dehava chakkim kol kach la chama. amar ribbi yose, chas veshalom dehahu rasha yistakkel bechezu kadisha. amar leh, i hachi, ha ketiv nofel ugeluy enayim. amar leh la shemana beha midi vela ema. amar leh ana shemana, dechad hava itzterich leistakkela, hava nafil vechame. vehasheta la itzterich leistakkela.

Amar leh, i hachi, bedarga illaa yattir hava al kol nevie mehemnuta, deihu geluy enayim, chame veistakkal bikara dekudesha berich hu. veha ribbi shimon amar, bilam becharshoy, hava yada beinnun kitrin tattain diltatta, kema dichtiv, (Yehoshua 13:22) veet bilam ben beor hakkosem, kosem karyeh kera, detinnufa detinnufe, hech yistakkal bikara demareh. veod, ha amar ribbi shimon, bechezu chad dechaza lefum shaata, dichtiv vaygal Adonai et ene bilam, itakimu enoy, veat amrat dehava chame begiluy deayynin, veistakkal bikara dekudesha berich hu.

Amar leh, ana ahadarna lokovlach. didi vedidach bae tzachuta. vadday raze orayyta illain, vela yachlin bene alma lemekam alayyhu. begin kach asir leakdema bemilla deorayyta, ad deyishma milla veyeda lah al bureyeh. atu lekammeh derabbi shimon amru milla kammeh.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 8:Adonai) ma enosh ki tizkerennu vegomer, hay kera ukemuha, dimmanan dealma amruha, beshaata desalik biruteh dekudesha berich hu lemivre enasha. kera lechittot kittot demalache illaa, veotiv lon kammeh. amar lon, baena lemivre adam. amru kammeh, (Tehillim 49:13) veadam bikar bal yalin vegomer. oshit kudesha berich hu etzbea dileh, veokid lon. otiv kittot acharanin kammeh, amar lon baena lemivre adam. amru kammeh,
1446: Ma enosh ki tizkerennu. ma tivu debar nash da. amar lon, bar nash diyhe betzalma didan, diyhe chachmeta dileh, illaa mechachmatchon.

Kevan devara adam, vechata, venafik bedimus kammeh, atu aza vaazzael, amru kammeh, pitchon pe it lan gabbach, ha bar nash deavdat chate kammach. amar lehu, ilmale tehevon shechiche gabbayyhu vechulei. ma avad kudesha berich hu. appil lon middarga kadisha dilhon min shemaya.

Amar rabbi shimon, hasheta ahadarna letiyyuvetayychu. devilam amar nofel ugeluy enayim, i nema dela hava hachi, veshabbuche ka meshabbach garmeh, hech yichtov kudesha berich hu milla kediva beorayyta. vei milla dikshot hi, hech yishtabbach hahu rasha bedarga illaa al kol nevie mehemnuta. veod, deha la sharya kedushsha dilella, ella beatreh deitchaze leh.

Hasheta ahadarna lemilla kadmaa. batar deafil lon kudesha berich hu, meatar kadisha dilhon. tau batar neshe alma, veatu alma. hacha it leistakkela, veha ketiv (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot vegomer. veha illen malachin havo, ech yachilu leitkayyeyma beara. ella ta chaze, kol innun (Melachim) dilella, la kayymin, vela yachlin lemekam, bar binhora illaa denahir lon, vekayyim lon. vei pasik minnayyhu hahu nehora dilella, la yachlin lemekam. kol shekken illen deafil lon kudesha berich hu. ufasak minnayyhu hahu nehora dilella, deishtane zivavyyhu. vechach nachtu veshalit behu avira dealma, ishtannu bedarga achara.

Ta chaze, mana dehava nachit lehu leyisrael bemadbera, hahu mana hava, mittalla dilella, dehava nachit meattika setima dechol setimin. vechad hava nachit, hava nehoreh nahir bechullehu almin, uminneh itzan chakal detappuchin, umalache illae. vechad hava nachit letatta, veshalit beh avira dealma, iglid, veishtane zivih, vela hava zivih ella kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 11:7) vehamman kizra gad hu vegomer, vela yatir. vechol shekken malachin, kevan denachtu veshalit behu avira, ishtannu mehahu darga kadmaa dahavo.

Ma avad kudesha berich hu. chama deatayayn alma, kashar lon beshalshelae defarzela betura dachashocha, bean atar yatve. beamika deture. otiv leh laaza, ureme chashocha deanpin. begin dehahi shaata dekashar lon kudesha berich hu, ittakkaf veargiz kelappe maala, vekudesha berich hu appil leh beumeka ad kedaleh, vezarik chashocha beanpoy. azael dela ittakkaf, otveh gaveh, venahir leh chashocha.

Uvene alma deyadin atrayyhu, atyayn legabbayyhu, veolfin lon livne nasha charshin unechashin ukesamin. veinnun ture chashocha, ikrun harare kedem. may tama. begin dachashocha akdim linhora. uvegin kach, ture chashocha, harare kedem ikrun. lavan uvilam minnayyhu olfe charshin. vehayeynu deamar bilam, min aram yancheni balak melech moav meharere kedem vegomer.

Ta chaze, bilam hava ka meshabbach garmeh mehay atar, veamar neum shomea imre el vegomer. begin daaza veazzael, amre leinnun bene alma, meillen millin illain, dahavo yade bekadmita leella. umishtae mealma kadisha dahavo beh, hada hu dichtiv shomea imre el. shomea kol el, la ketiv, ella imre el, innun amiran deamre minneh. man deate mippirka, veshaalin leh mean at ate. amar, millemishma millin demalka kaddisha. kach neum shomea imre el. veyodea daat elyon, dehava yada shaata detalya dina bealma, umechavvin shaata becharshoy.

Asher machaze shadday yechoze, man machaze shadday. illen innun nofel uggeluy enayim. veillen innun (lecha lecha 88 amud bet, lekamman 212 amud alef, pinchas 232 amud alef) aza veazael. nofel: da aza, deamik leh kudesha berich hu beumeka chashocha, veyativ beumeka ad kedaleh kidkaamran, vachashocha izderak beanpoy. veal da ikre nofel. nafal zimna chada min shemaya, venafal zimna achara, levatar, beumeka dachashocha. azael: hu geluy enayim, deha la izderak chashocha aleh, dela ittakkaf, vela argiz kehahu dilella.
1447: Uvilam kare lon machaze shadday, deinnun nofel ugeluy enayim.

Uvehahu zimna, la ishtear bealma, deyishtechach gabbayyhu, bar ihu. uvechol yoma, hava astim beinnun ture immehon. hada hu dichtiv, yancheni balak melech moav meharare kedem. meharare kedem vadday, vela meeretz bene kedem.

Amar rabbi shimon, kama zimnin amena milla da, vela mistakkele chavrayyay, deha kudesha berich hu la sharya shechinta, ella baatar kadisha, baatar deitchaze lesharya aloy. vechen kudesha berich hu machriz veamar, (Devarim 18:10) lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno vegomer. vehu deate (sefer acher ate) leitarva bahadayyhu. ella zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu kaddish lon lesharya benayyhu. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Devarim 23:15) ki Adonai elohecha mithallech bekerev machanecha vegomer. uvegin dehu mithallech bekkerev machanecha, ketiv vehaya machanecha kadosh vegomer. uchetiv (Vayikra 20:7) vihyitem kedoshim vegomer. uchetiv (Vayikra 18:24) al tittammeu bechol elle vegomer. uchetiv (Vayikra 20:23) vaakutz bam vegomer. dela yachilna lekarva gabbayyhu, vesharu li levar. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, vezakkaa chulakehon dinvie mehemne kadishe, deinnun kadishin, veit lon chulaka leishtammesha bikdushsha illaa.

(Bamidbar 22:23) vattere haaton et malach Adonai nitztzav baderech vecharbo shelufa beyado, (sefer acher bederech), behahu archa dehava ishteka (sefer acher ishtechach) begavvav. vecharbo shelufa beyado, vechi i ihu nafik lokovel hay aton, may bae charba. vei ihu nafik lokovleh devilam, amay chamat ataneh, veihu la chama. ella kolla izdeman. hahu malacha mizdeman lokovleh deaton, leappaka lah min hahu archa deittean bah. uvema. berachame. veizdeman lokovleh devilam, leanesha leh, al deihu hava bae lemehach birshuteh, vela birshuta achara (sefer acher dilella).

Amar ribbi yose, hasheta it leshaala, i milloy havo atyayn missitra dechitrin tattain, vela meatar achara, amay ketiv vayyavo elohim el bilam vegomer, veach et haddavar vegomer. amar ribbi yitzchak (beginehon deyisrael ithaddar malacha lemallala immeh. dei tema dekudesha berich hu mallil immeh vehu amar ach et haddavar vegomer. chas veshalom deha hahu malacha amar leh veefes et haddavar vegomer, dei tema vayyomer elohim el bilam vegomer.) hachi olifna. dehay elohim dehacha kullehu malacha hava. vehahu ihu atar deate missitra dedina kashya, deveh achidan chela vetukepa deinnun kitrin tattain, dehava mishtammesh behu bilam. uvegin kach, vayyavo elohim el bilam. vayyomer elohim el bilam. dilzimnin itkere malacha bishma illaa.

Vattet haaton min hadderech, sataat min hahu archa, dahavat teina missitra dedina kashya, lokovlehon deyisrael. uvema chama bilam, dehi sataat mehahu archa. ella hachi amar rabbi shimon, deafillu bearcha, baa leavasha lehu leyisrael, bechela daataneh. vechevan dela salik bidoy, ma ketiv, vayyach et haaton bammakkel. atan lah, vealbash lah, beziruzi dina kashya takifa. hada hu dichtiv bamakel. bamakel dayyka. deihu dina kashya takkifa. bemaklo la ketiv, ella bammakkel.
Puk chame, kama takkifa chachmeta dehahu rasha, vetiuveta dileh leavasha lehon leyisrael, deihu ashgach lenafka mershuta dilella, begin detiuveteh leityaykkera, uleavasha lehu leyisrael.

(Bamidbar 22:24) vayyaamod malach Adonai bemishol hakkeramim vegomer. ma ketiv leella, bekadmita ketiv, vattet haaton min hadderech vattelech bassade, vattelech beorach meshar, missitra desade, (ittear) veirchinat mimma dehava bah. vayyach bilam et haaton lehattotah haddarech leastaa lah mehahu archa desade. amar ribbi yose, ben malacha uven bilam havat atana beaku. levatar kad chama bilam, dela hava yachil, keden vayyach et haaton bammakkel. kema deittemar.
Vayyaamod malach Adonai vegomer. amar ribbi abba, kama it lan leistakkela bemille deorayyta, hane kerae remize
1448: Bechachmeta illaa. vechi lemagana nafak hay malacha, leitchazaa lechad atana. o lemekam ben karmayyay lokovlah, zimna hacha vezimna hacha. ella kolla raza illaa hu, vecholla bae kudesha berich hu begin leaggana alayyhu deyisrael, vela yishletu behu zinin bishin, begin deinnun chulakeh dekudesha berich hu.

Vayyaamod malach Adonai vegomer. tana, missitra deimma, kad ihi mitattera, nafkin beitraha elef vachamesh mea sitre gelifin betachshitaha. vechad baat leizdavvevga bemalka, mitattera bechad atara dearba gevavnin. (gavvnin) innun gevavnin mitlahatan bearba sitre alma, kol gevavna ugevavna mitlahata telat zimnin behahu sitra. deinnun teresar techume gelifin. vealin veitkelilu bitresar acharanin.

Beresha deatara, it 4 shurin led sitrin, veinnun migdalot, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim Adonai:13) migdelot merkachim. mahu merkachim. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 3:6) mikkol avkat rochel. veal kol magdela umagdela 3 pitchin, keviin beavnin tavan, mikkol sitra vesitra. hay atara, nehira (sefer acher taheyrea) (sefer acher temira) bedillugin deofir, begin yekara demalka, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 13:12) okir enosh mippaz vegomer.

Techot atara, talyayn zage dedahava besacharanaha, zaga dedahava missitra da, vezaga dedahava missitra da, vechad rimmona. (sefer acher bego) kegavavn hahu rimmona, it bah elef zagin, vechol zaga minnayyhu, mitlahata besumaka bechivvavra. hahu rimmona itpelag befillugin arba, vekayyeyma peticha, leitchazaa zagaha. telat mea veesrin vachamesh zagin lesitra da, vechen lechol sitra vesitra, ad demitlahatan arba sitre alma, mechezu dechol pilcha ufilcha, veinnun ikrun pelach harimmon. kema dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:3) kefelach harimmon rakkatech mibbaad letzammatech.

Arba galgallin befilche arba zavyayn, natlin begilgula lehahu atara, vechad natle lah, izdakkefan leella. ad dematu legilgula defilcha illaa, denahim yemama velelya, mitchabberan kol innun pilchin, venatlin leatra, vezakfan lah. vekala deinnun galgallin, ishtema bechullehu rekiin. lekal neimuta mitraashin kol chele shemaya, vechullehu shaalin da leda, ad dechullehu amre (Yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo.

Kad mizdavvivg malka bematronita, salleka atara da, veityashavat beresha dematronita. keden nachit chad atara illaa, kevia dechol even tava, vechezur veshushan, besacharanaha. beshit galgallin atya, leshit sitrin dealma, shit gadpin denesher natlin lah. befilchoy chamshin (sefer acher palekayn) anavin sacharanaha, degalif bah imma illaa. kevian beeven tava, chivvavr vesumak yarok veucham techela veargevavna. shit mea utelat asar ziuuyin, lechol sitra vesitra.

Elef veshit mea migdalin, lechol sitra vesitra. vechol magdela umagdela, turin keviin. parchin leella, ishtaavan bechittuna (sefer acher befatora) deimma illaa, bimshach revut dilah. keden imma, bilchishu, nagid mattenan illain, veshadar vekava lon behahu atara. levatar angid nachale dimshach revut kaddisha, al resha demalka. umeresheh, nachit hahu mishcha tava illaa, al dikneh yakkira. umittamman nagid al innun levushe malka. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh yored al hazzakan vegomer.

Levatar ithaddar atara, umeattera leh imma illaa behahu atara, uferisa aleh, veal matronita, levushe yekar behahu atara. keden kala ishtema bechullehu almin, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena vegomer. keden chedvavta hu bechol innun bene malka. uman innun. kol innun deatu missitrayyhu deyisrael. deha la mizdavvevge behu, vela kayymin immehon, bar innun yisrael, deinnun bene beta, umeshamshe lehu. keden birchan dinfike minnayyhu, deyisrael hu.
Veyisrael natlin kolla, umeshaddere chulaka minneh lishar ammin, umehahu chulaka ittezanu kol innun shear ammin. vetana, mibben sitre chulakehon dimmanan al shear ammin, nafik
1449: Chad shevil dakik, demittamman, itnegid chulaka leinnun tattae, umittamman mitperash lechamma sitrin. veda karenan leh tamtzit, denafik missitra deara kaddisha.

Veal da alma kuleh mittamtzit deeretz yisrael ka shate. man eretz yisrael. ha okimna. uven leella, uven letatta, kol innun shear ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, la ittezanu ella mehahu tamtzit. vela tema deinnun bilchodoy, ella afillu innun kitrin tattain, mehahu tamtzit shatyayn. veda hu bemishol hakkeramim, shevil meravreve shear ammin demitbarchan minneh.

Kad chama hahu malacha, deha bilam aste laaton lehahu shevila, dichtiv lehattotah haddarech, miyyad vayyaamod malach Adonai bemishol hakkeramim, leastema shevila, dela yistayyun beh innun shear ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, veinnun kitrin tattain. veazla ha, keha deamar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv (Shir HaShirim 1) samuni notera vegomer, lenatra ulevarcha lishar ammin begaluta. veyisrael deinun karmi shelli, lo natarti, begin deinnun begaluta, vela mitbarchin kaddeka chaze.

Gader mizze vegader mizze. amar ribbi abba, hech yachil hahu malacha leastema hahu shevila. ella begin desiua achara hava leh, kudesha berich hu ucheneset yisrael. ribbi yehuda amar, orayyta mesayyeya leh, dichtiv, (Shemot 32:15) mizze umizze hem ketuvim.

Behahi shaata ma ketiv. vattere haaton vegomer, vattillachetz el hakkir, may vattillachetz el hakkir. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 22:5) mekarkar kir vegomer. kir: patrona, hahu deshalta alayyhu. vattillechatz et regel bilam el hakkir, hi la yahava leh siyyua kelal. uveakuta, (sefer acher ashdot) ashrat (sefer acher ashedaret) leh lehahu kir. veramza leh hay, keden vayyosef lehakkotah behay sitra.

Vayosef malach Adonai avor vayyaamod bemakom tzar vegomer. behahi shaata, astim lah kol orchin, vechol siyyuin, dela ishtechach bah mikkol sitra dealma siyyua. keden vattirbatz tachat bilam. kad chama bilam dela hava yachil, ma ketiv. vayyichar af bilam vayyach et haaton bammakkel, kema deittemar, deatan lah, vealbash lah, beziruze dina kashya takkifa.

(Bamidbar 22:28) veyyiftach Adonai et pi haaton vegomer. hayeynu chad meinnun millin, deitberiu erev shabbat ben hashshemashot. amar ribbi yitzchak, may sagge hay levilam, o laaton, o leyisrael. behane millin. amar ribbi yose, dechayychin beh innun ravrevin dahavo immeh, vechad matu levalak, amru leh, vechi lehay shatya shadrat leyakra, la tishkach beh mammashut, vela bemilloy. uveinnun milla daatana, itbeza min yekareh. ribbi chiyyay amar ilmale la amrat atana hay, la shavik bilam hahu dileh, uvemille daatana yada deittebar cheleh.

Ribbi abba rame, ketiv (Bamidbar 16:32) vattiftach haaretz vegomer. uchetiv veyyiftach Adonai et pi vegomer. may shena eretz meaton, dela ketiv bah veyyiftach Adonai et pi haaretz. ella, hatam moshe gazar al puma, ufatchat, veavdat ara pikkuda demoshe, vela yaut dekudesha berich hu yaavor pikkudeh, deha moshe gazar ufakid, (Bamidbar 16:30) ufatzta haadama et piha. veal da hi avdat pikkudoy. dichtiv vattiftach haaretz et piha. aval hacha, la ishtechach man degazar, ella reuta dekudesha berich hu hava, vehoil ureuteh hava bechach, ketiv veyyiftach Adonai et pi haaton. minneh ata milla, uminneh ishtechach.

Ribbi yehuda amar, istakkalna befarashta da, uveillen millin, veitchazzeyayn delav millin ditzrichin innun. vechi meachar dichtiv veyyiftach Adonai et pi haaton, bayayn lemehevi innun millin mille mealleyayta, mille dechachmeta, vei kema deattearu chavrana, deihu meshabbach desuseya dileh rae birtiva, vehi tavat veamrat, halo anochi atoncha. mehacha hava lah lemiftach, vehi la patcha ella me asiti lecha. vei hachi, amay ka tarach kudesha berich hu, lemiftach pumah lehane millin.
Amar ribbi abba, vadday beillen millin olifna data devilam, delav keday hu lemishre aleh ruach kudesha, veolifna, deha let yachilu beatneh, leavasha o
1450: Leotava. veolifna mehay aton, deha let chela bivire leashraa alayyhu data shelim. ta chaze, bilam, behahi milla daataneh, uvehahu data tippesha la yachil lemekam. bedata illaa al achat kama vechamma.

(Bamidbar 22:28) vattomer levilam me asiti lecha. vechi birshuti hava lemebad tav uvish. lav. deha beire la mitnahagan, ella bema denahagu lon. veaf al gav dehahi atana beamikta (sefer acher beakta) yattir, lav birshutah hi, deha hu atin lah becharshoy, uvirshuteh kayyeyma.

Vayyomer bilam laaton ki hitallalt bi. hava leh lechayyeycha minnah, vehu ativ lakavla tippeshuta demillaha, keden chayychu minneh, veitkelil beenayyhu, veyadu deihu shatya. uma amar. ki hitallalt bi lu yesh cherev beyadi. amru, shatya da ihu yachil leshetzaa ammin befumeh, hech la yachil leshetzaa leatneh, vehu bae charba. veolifna, delet chela bivire leashraa alayyhu rucha achara, dei yemrun bene nasha, i yemallelun beire, kamma data shelim yippekun lealma, puk veolif mehay atana, deha kudesha berich hu aftach pumah, chame milloy. (matzati katuv baheatekavet, chaser kan)

Vayhi vabboker vayyikkach balak et bilam vegomer. ribbi yitzchak amar, balak chakkim hava becharshin, yatir mibbilam, bar dela hava mechavvivn shaata lelatyay. mashal vechulei. begin kach vayyikkach balak et bilam vegomer. hu hava atkin leh veachid leh lecholla.

Vayyaalehu bamot baal. may vayyaalehu bamot baal. ella ashgach becharshoy, bemay sitra yitachid behu, veashkach dizminin yisrael lemebad bamot, ulemiflach labbaal. kema dichtiv, vayyelchu achare habbaal. vayyar mishsham ketze haam, chama ravreve deamma, umalka dilhon, defalchin leh, kema dichtiv (Melachim 1 18:26) veyikreu veshem habbaal, uchetiv (Melachim 1 18:21) im Adonai haelohim vegomer. kevan dechama bilam, dizminin yisrael lehay, miyyad vayyomer bilam el balak bene li vaze shiva mizbechot. (chaser ketiv)

Ribbi yose veribbi yehuda, chad amar lokovle madbechan dekadmae, akriv innun shiva madbechan. vechad amar, bechachmeta aved kolla, veashkach dechulakehon deyisrael beshiva dargin itkeshsharu. begin kach asdar shiva madbechan.

Lebar nash dehava leh rechima chad, deshavak leh avoy. uvene nasha mistafu lekatteta bahadeh, begin hahu rechima. leyomin, ata bar nash chad, uvaa leatara ketatu bahadeh. amar, ma abed, i atar beh ketata, ha hahu rechima deitkeshar bahadeh, vela yachilna, amar ma avad, shadar leh doron lehahu rechima. amar hahu rechima, vechi ma it leh lehay bar nash gabbay, yedana divgin hahu bar rechimay hu. amar, hay doron la yeul kammay, zeminu leh lechalbe veyechluneh.

Kach bilam, ata leatara ketatu behu beyisrael, vechama dela yachil begin hahu rechima illaa dilhon, (kema deat amar 0 reecha vara avicha el taazaveb.) share letakkena kammeh doron. amar kudesha berich hu, rasha uma it lach gabbay, at bae leizdavvevga bevnay, hare doronach zammin lechalbe. ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyikkar elohim el bilam. veamar rabbi shimon, lashon keri vetumea. doronach leillen itmesar vela yeul kammay.

Ribbi abba amar, vayyikkar: kema deat amer, (Tehillim 147:17) lifne karato mi yaamod. hu hava zammin, divhahu doron, yachil behu beyisrael. ma ketiv. vayyikkar elohim. karir garmeh min da dehava chashiv. vayyikkar elohim, kema deittemar, deitar aleh missitra dimsaavuta.

Ribbi elazar amar, vayyikkar, bilam chashiv divhahu doron yeul leavasha lehu leyisrael, vekudesha berich hu akar leh mikkammeh lehahu doron. veakar leh levilam, mimma dehava chashiv. veakar (sefer acher leh mehahu darga), lehahu darga hada hu dichtiv vayyikkar. kema deat amer (Mishlei 36) yikkeruha orve nachal. amar leh, rasha, let annet keday leitkashshera bahaday
1451: Amar ribbi shimon, ta chaze, hay rasha, gaala decholla hava. dela tishkach bechol parashta da, vayyomer Adonai el bilam, o vaydabber Adonai, chas veshalom. ma ketiv. vayyasem Adonai davar befi bilam vegomer, keman deshavvi chisma befum chamara, dela yiste hacha o hacha, kach vayyasem Adonai davar befi vegomer.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, at chashiv deal yedach yehe veyitkayyem beracha bevanay, o ippecha. la tzerichin innun lach, kema deamrin latztzira vechulei. ella at shuv el balak, vechad tiftach pumach, la yehe birshutach. vela befumach talyay millula, ella vecho tedabber. hare ko, dizmina levarcha lon. ko, temallel beracha divnay, dechad tiftach pumach, hi temallel millin, leitkayyeyma al benay, dela eshbok millin lach.

Ta chaze, dechach hu, kevan deata levalak, uvalak shama kol innun millin, hava chashiv deha mippumeh devilam nafkin, amar, lakov oyvay lekachticha. amar bilam. sav illen charshin bidach, begin leakava hacha lehay ko, vei at techul leakeva (sefer acher leakera) lah behay charshin, ana akar lah meinnun millin dehi amra.

Ma ketiv, hityatztzev ko al olatecha, behay, uveillen charshin, teakkev lah, veanochi ikkare ko, kelomar, akar lah meillen millin. amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, ana akar lach. ma ketiv batreh. vayyikkar elohim el bilam. vehahu davar arim kala, bemilule decho. vayyomer shuv el balak vecho tedabber, ko tedabber vadday.

Ta chaze, bekadmita la ketiv hityatztzev ko al olatecha, ella hityatztzev al olatecha veelcha ulay yikkare Adonai likrati. kevan dechama decho amar innun birchan, keden amar hityatztzev ko al olatecha, veanochi ikkare ko.

Lecha ara li yaakov, kelomar, lekot. ribbi yose amar, ashde lon mehahu darga deinnun kayyme, kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 20:20) tziddah ore. amar, i techul lemishde (sefer acher lon mehahu darga) lehahu darga dilhon, ha kullehu itakaru mealma. ulecha zoama yisrael, yisrael dilella, deyishtechach rugeza kammeh, kema deat amer (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom.

(Bamidbar 23:9) ki merosh tzurim vegomer. amar ribbi yitzchak, merosh tzurim, illen innun avahata. dichtiv (Yeshayahu 51:1) habbitu el tzur chutztzavtem. umiggevaot ashurenu, illen immahan, ben mehay sitra uven mehay sitra, la yachlin leitlatteyay.

Ribbi abba amar, ki merosh tzurim, man yachil lehu leyisrael, deha hu achid meresha dechol tzurim nafkin (Shemot 64), uman innun tzurim. gevuran. deha kol dinin dealma meinnun gevuran nafke, veinnun itachadan behu. umiggevaot ashurenu, illen shear mashiryayn (sefer acher kitrin) deitachadan behu. hen am levadad vegomer. kema deat amer (Devarim 32:12) Adonai badad yanchennu.

Mi mana afar yaakov vegomer, ha ukemuha. ella amar ribbi yose, teren dargin innun, yaakov veyisrael. bekadmita yaakov, ulevatar yisrael. veaf al gav decholla chad, teren dargin innun, deha darga illaa yisrael hu.

Mi mana afar yaakov vegomer. letatta, man hu afar. ribbi shimon amar, hay dichtiv beh (Yeshayahu 41:2) yitten keafar charbo vegomer. man charbo. ha yedia, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 34:6) cherev laAdonai mala dam. afar, hahu atar deitbere minneh adam harishon, dichtiv (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitzer Adonai elohim et haadam afar vegomer. umehahu afar, kamma chayyaylin, vekamma mashiryayn nafku, kamma tafsin, kama gardine nimusin, kamma girin, kamma balisteraot, kama rumechin, vesayyfin, vezayynin, ishtechachu mehahu afar. (mi mane) kema deat amer, (Iyov 25:3) hayesh mispar ligdudav.

Umispar et rova yisrael. rova yisrael hi hei, vechad milla hi. rova yisrael, kema deat amer (Shemot 23:5) rovetz tachat massao, revia hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:7) mittato shellishlomo. davar acher rova, kemo reviit miyisrael letatta, rova itkere lefum kitrin mashma david, deihu ragla reviaa dechuresyay.
Davar acher mi mana afar yaakov vegomer, kol innun dachashivin afra, kema deokimna. umispar et rova yisrael, dichtiv hayesh mispar ligdudav. rova yisrael kema
1452: Deokimna. davar acher mi mana afar, innun pikudin deinnun beafra, bizria, bintia, bechatzda, veha ukemuha chavrayyay. umispar et rova, kema deat amer (Vayikra 19:19) behemtecha lo tarbia. (amar rabbi abba, balak chakkim hava becharshoy kevilam. bar dela yada lechiuun shaata lelatya).

(Bamidbar 23:7) veyissa meshalo vayyomar. vaydabber la ketiv, may veyissa meshalo. ribbi chiyyay amar, hu hava zakif kala legabbe hahu memallel, veyyissa meshalo bilam. vayyomar hay ko kema dichtiv vecho tedabber, vaamira minnah hava.

Ta chaze, kevan dechama bilam divchol charashoy uvechol hahu doron, la yachil leakera hahu ko, kema deat amer veanochi ikkare ko, akar lehay ko. amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, annet savur leakera lah, ana akar lach mishshelshulach, ma ketiv. vayyikkar elohim el bilam, kema deittemar. levatar, kevan dechama dela yachil, hadar veamar, uverech velo ashivenna, velo ashivennu mibbae leh. ella velo ashivenna vday, lehahi dichtiv ko, veko tedabber. let ana yachil leahaddera lah.

Amar bilam, bitren dargin baena leaala behu. baena leaala behu middarga deyaakov, vela yachilna. baena leaala behu missitra achara deyisrael, vela yachilna. may taama. begin dishma da o da, la itkeshar bezinin bishin, hada hu dichtiv lo hibbit avn beyaakov vegomer.

Tana, teren dargin innun: nachash, vekesem. lokovlehon: amal, vaavn. amar bilam, ha vadday ashkachna lokovle dehane yaakov veyisrael. avn, lokovleh deyaakov, deihu katir benachash. amal, lekavleh deyisrael, deihu katir bekesem. kevan dechama dela yachil, amar, vadday lo hibbit avn beyaakov vegomer. may tama. begin daAdonai elohav immo vegomer.

Vei tema, behane la yachilna. bekesem venachash yachilna. ketiv ki lo nachash beyaakov vegomer. velo od, ella dechol chelin dilella, vechol mashiryayn kullehu, la yade vela mistakkele benimusa demalka illaa, ad deshaale lehane tere yaakov veyisrael. umay amre. ma paal el. amar ribbi elazar, kol hane millin, ko amar, vehu arim kala lokovlah, vela yada may hu, vela ishtema bar kaleh.

Hen am kelavi yakum vegomer, man amma takkifa keyisrael. beshaata deitnehir tzafra, kam umitgabbar kearya, lefulechana demarehon, bechamma shirin, bechamma tushebchan. mishtaddele beorayyta kol yoma, uvallayla lo yishkav vegomer. kad bae bar nash lemishkav al arseh, mekaddesh shema illaa, amlich leh leella vetatta. kama gardine nimusin mitkashsheran kammayyhu, beshaata defatchin pumehon al arsayyhu, bishma yisrael. uvaan rachame kamme malka kaddisha, bechamma kerae derachame.

Ribbi abba amar, hen am kelavi yakum. zeminin hay amma, lemekam al kol ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, kearye gibbar vetakkif, veyitreme alayyhu. archayyhu dechol aryayvavta lemishkav al tarpayyhu, aval amma da la yishkav, ad yochal teref.

Davar acher hen am kelavi yakum, lekarva karbenin veillavavn kamme malkehon, al gabbe madbecha. vetana, beshaata dekurebna ittokad al gabbe madbecha, havo chaman diyyukena dechad arye revia al hahu karbena, veachil leh.

Veamar ribbi abba, uriel malacha illaa hava, vechaman leh bediyyukena dearya takifa, revia al madbecha, veachil lon lekarbenin. vechad yisrael la havo zakkain kol kach, havo chaman diyyukena dechad kalba chatzifa revia aleh, keden havo yade yisrael devayayn teshuva, ucheden tayyvan. lo yishkav vegomer, illen karbenin delelya kegon allavavn. vedam chalalim yishte, dekudesha berich hu agach kerava dilhon al sanehon.
Ribbi elazar amar, lo yishkav, mahu lo yishkav. ella bechol lelya velelya, kad bar nash ihu azil befikkude demareh, la
1453: Shachiv al arseh, ad dekatil elef umea veesrim vachamesh, meinnun zayynin bishin, desharyayn immeh. ribbi abba amar, elef innun distar semala, dichtiv, (Tehillim 91:7) yippol mitztziddecha elef. kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 149:5) yalezu chasidim vechavod vegomer, (Tehillim 149:5) rommot el bigronam vegomer, laasot nekama vegomer, hada hu dichtiv lo yishkav vegomer veda hu laasot bahem mishpat vegomer.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, lokovle telat zimnin dehu macha leatneh, veatin lah becharshoy, itbarchun yisrael telat zimnin. ribbi chiyyay amar, lokovle itbarchun yisrael telat zimnin, desallekin yisrael leitchazaa kamme malka kaddisha.

(Bamidbar 23) vayyar bilam ki tov beene Adonai vegomer, velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim vegomer. may likrat nechashim. amar ribbi yose, dehane teren zimnin kadmae, hava azil bechol charashoy, uvaa lemelat leyisrael. kevan dechama reuteh dekudesha berich hu, deamar shuv el balak, deha millulach la bayayn banay. millula ochara zammin mehay ko, kema dichtiv vecho tedabber. ko tedabber, vela annet. ko tedabber, deshalta al kol shalitin charshin vekismin vezinin bishin, dela yachlin leavasha livnay. keden baa leistakkela behu, beena bisha.

Ta chaze, hay rasha kad istakkal behu beyisrael, hava mistakkal beillen teren dargin yaakov veyisrael, leavasha lon, o behay o behay becharashoy, begin kach kol birkan uvirkan yaakov veyisrael itberichu. vayyar bilam ki tov vegomer. bame chama chama di beshaata deanfe malka nehirin, zinin bishin la kayyme bekiyyumayyhu, vechol charshin vechol kismin la sallekan becharshayyhu.

Ta chaze, behane tere zemane ketiv vayyikkar. vayyekkar elohim. vayyikkar Adonai el bilam vegomer. uchetiv vecho tedabber. vehasheta kevan dechama deha la ishtechach rugeza, vecharshoy la sallekin, keden velo halach kefaam befaam vegomer. kevan deafrish veistallak garmeh mecharshoy, share (berucha achara) beitaruta achara leshabbecha leyisrael. amar ribbi yehuda, may ittearuta hacha. amar leh, (ruach elohim velo ruach Adonai ella) ittearuta derucha chada missitra dismala, hahu deitkesharu techotoy innun zinin vecharashin dileh.

Amar ribbi elazar, hachi olifna, deafillu hay zimna la sharya beh rucha dekudesha. amar leh ribbi yose, i hachi, ha ketiv vattehi alav ruach elohim, uvechol innun zimnin acharanin la ketiv behu hachi. amar leh hachi hu. ta chaze, ketiv (Mishlei 22:9) tov ayin hu yevorach, veha ukemuha al tikre yevorach. ella yevarech. uvilam hava ra ayin, dela ishtechach ra ayin bealma kevavteh, divchol atar dehava mistakkal beenoy, hava mitlatteyay. veal da amru, hay man deabar bereh beshuka, umistafe meena bisha, yecheppe sudera al resheh, begin dela yachil ena bisha leshalletaa aleh. uf hacha, kevan dechama bilam, dela yachil becharshoy vekismoy leavasha leyisrael, baa leistakkol behu beena bisha, begin divchol atar dehava mistakkal beenoy bishin, hava mitlatteyay.
Ta chaze ma reuteh dileh lakovlehon deyisrael, ketiv vayyashett el hammidbar panav, ketargumo, (veshavvi 0 leegla di avdo yisrael bemadbera appohi), begin diyhe leh setar siyyua, leavasha lehu.

Hasheta chame ma ketiv, vayyissa bilam et enav vayyar et yisrael. baa leistakkela behu beena bisha. beh shaata, ilmale deakdim lon kudesha berich hu asvavta, hava meabbed lon beistakkeluta deenoy. umay asvavta yahav kudesha berich hu leyisrael behahi shaata. da hu dichtiv vattehi alav ruach elohim. vattehi alav, al yisrael kaamar. keman defarish sudera al resheh deyyannuka, begin dela yishlot behu enoy.

Keden share veamar, ma tovu ohalecha yaakov. ta chaze, kol man devae leistakkela beena bisha, la yachil, ella kad meshabbach veokir lehahu milla, devae lealteyay beena bisha. uma archeh. amar, chamu kama tava da. kama yaa da. begin deyishlot beh ena bisha. uf hacha amar, ma tovu oholecha yaakov, kama innun yaan, kama
1454: Innun shappiran, kama netian shappiran deitnetaan minayyhu, damyayn leinnun netiin denata kudesha berich hu beginta deeden yaayayn. man yitten, veillen (nusach acher deillen) netian ishtechachu meinnun mishkene, divhu.

(Bamidbar 24:7) yizzal mayim middalleyav vegomer. lebar nash dahavo leh yedan shappiran, yaan lemecheze. abar chad bar nash deena bisha, istakkal beinnun yedin, nakit behu, share leshabbecha, amar, kama innun shappiran, kama innun yaan, chamu etzbean miggezera deshappiru illaa. levatar amar, man yitten yedin illen desharyayn ben avanin yakirin, uvilvushe yekar deargevavna (sefer acher babeyteay vechulei betevuta dileh) beveteh leishtammesha behu, veyehon genizin betevuta dileh.

Kach bilam, share leshabbecha, ma tovu ohalecha, chamu kamma shepiran, kamma yaan vechulei, levatar amar yizzal mayim middalleyav, la yishtekach netia shappira da, netia deorayyta, levar meinnun maskenin (dalyu, kelomar maskenin) (nusach acher mishkanin), vezaro bemayim rabbim, dela yisge vela yarbe rucha dekudesha.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, rasha, la yachlin enayich leavasha, ha perisu dekudesha alayyhu, keden amar, el motzio mimmitzrayim vegomer, ha la yachlin kol bene alma leavasha lon, deha chela takkifa illaa achid behu, umay ihu. el motzio mimmitzrayim. velo od, ella ketoafot reem lo, dela yachil bar nash leoshit yedeh aleh, miggo rumeh. umiddeishtechach bizkifu illaa hachi, yochal goyim tzarav vegomer. velet man deyachil leavasha lon.

Vaafillu bezimna dela zakif, la yachlin, hada hu dichtiv kara shachav. la dachil, begin deishtechach gibbar kaari uchelavi, afillu kad innun bene ammaya, vechara veshachav benayyhu, kaari hu yishtekach benimuse orayyta, beorche orayyta. (veaf al pi ken) shuletanuta it lehu bemarehon, deafillu kol malchayya dealma, la yakerun lehu. kearya da kad shachiv al tarfeh, la yachlin leakkama leh minneh, hada hu dichtiv kara shachav kaari vegomer.

Amar ribbi elazar, la ishtechach bealma chakkim leavasha, kevilam reshia, deha bekadmita hava ishtechach bemitzrayim, veal yedoy, keshiru mitzrae alayyhu deyisrael kishshura, dela yippekun meavdutehon lealmin. veda hu deamar, ma echul leavasha lehu, deha ana avidna dela yippekun meavidata demitzrae lealmin, aval el motzio, mimmitzrayim ulokovlehon (nusach acher ulekovleh) la yachlin chakkimin vacharashin dealma.

(Bamidbar 24:14) veatta hinni holech leammi vegomer ribbi yehuda patach, (Devarim 23:17) lo tasgir eved el adonav vegomer immecha yeshev bekirbecha. kama chavivin mille deorayyta. kama chaviva orayyta kamme kudesha berich hu. kama chaviva orayyta, deorit lah kudesha berich hu likkeneset yisrael. ta chaze, beshaata di nafku mimmitzrayim. shema bilam deha charashoy vekismoy, vechol innun kishrin, la seliku behu beyisrael, share legarra garmeh, ulemerat resheh. azal leinnun ture chashocha, umata legabbe innun shalshelae defarzela.

Vechach hu archa deman demate gabbayyhu, kevan deal bar nash bereshe turayya, chame leh azael, hahu deikre geluy enayim. miyyad amar laaza, keden yahavin kala, umitkanneshin gabbayyhu chivyayn ravreve dimtokdan, vesacharin lon. meshaddere onimta zeerta lokovleh debar nash, vetana, kemin shunera, hi, vereshe keresha dechivyay, uteren zanvin bah, vidaha veraglaha zeirin. bar nash dechame lah, chappe anpoy, vehu mayyte chad katureta, meokidu detarnegola chivvavra, shade beanpaha vehi atyat immeh.

Ad demate legabbe resha deshalshelae, vehahi resha deshalshelae, naitz beara, umate ad tehoma. vetamman bithoma. chad samich, vehu naitz bithoma tattaa, uvehahu samich itkeshar resha deshalshelae. kad mate bar nash leresha deshalshelaa, batash bah 3 zimnin, veinnun karan leh, keden kara vesagid al birkoy, veazil veatim enoy, ad demate gabbayyhu. keden yativ kammayyhu, vechol innun chivyayn sacharin leh mehay sitra umehay sitra. patach enoy, vechame lon, izdaza, venafal al anpoy, vesagid lokovlayyhu.
Levatar olfin leh charashin vekismin, veyativ gabbayyhu
1455: 50 Yomin. kad mata zimna lemehach learcheh, hahi onimta, vechol innun chivyayn, azlin kammeh, ad denafik min turayyay, ben hahu chashocha takkifa.

Uvilam kad mata gabbayyhu, oda lon milla, veasgar garmeh beturayay immehon. uvaa lekatrega lon, leatava lon lemitzrayim. vekudesha berich hu bilbel vekilkel kol chachmeta dealma, vechol charashin dealma, dela yachilu lekarva bahadayyhu.

Ta chaze, hasheta kevan dechama bilam dela yachil leavasha leyisrael, ahdar garmeh, veamlich leh levalak, ma dela baa mineh, begin leavasha lon. veeta dileh hava beinnun nukeve demidyan deinnun shappiran, veilmale deamar leh moshe, la havina yada, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 31:16) hen henna hayu livne yisrael bidvar bilam.

Kevan dechama kudesha berich hu eta dileh, amar, ha vadday garmach beitech yippol. ma aved, hahu chela deshalat al kol charashin, achme leh sofa decholla. vechi it lehu reshuta lizman rachik. amar ribbi yitzchak, ena chama, umillin itmaru mehahu dekaim aleh, veha ukemuha. vayyissa meshalo vayyomar. man deit leh lememar. may tama. begin dela yitkayyeymun millin degala, biruta illaa, (sefer acher uvegin deyitkayymun millin dilella) bedata illaa beorayyta.

(Bamidbar 24:17) erennu velo atta, deha millin illen minnayyhu itkayyaymu behahu zimna, uminnayyhu levatar, uminnayyhu bezimna demalka meshicha. (45 shechaser kan timtza bazzohar chodesh daf 68 amud alef 380) tenan, zammin kudesha berich hu lemivne yerushalam, uleachzaa chad kochava kevia, menatztzetza be rahatin, uve zikin naharin minneh beemtzaut rekia, veyishtaalun beh 70 kochavin acharanin, vihe nahir velahit 70 yomin.

Uveyoma shetitaa, yitchaze bech yomin leyarcha shetitaa, veyitkenish beyoma sheviaa, lesof 70 yomin, yoma kadmaa yitchaze bekarta (chada) deroma. vehahu yoma yinpelun 3 shurin illain mehahi karta deromi, vehechala ravreva yinpol, veshallita dehahi karta yemut. keden yitpashshat hahu kochava leitchazaa bealma. uvehahu zimna yittearun keravin takkifin bealma, lechol 4 sitrin, umehemnuta la yishtekach benayyhu.
Uveemtzaut alma, kad yittenhir hahu kochava, beemtzaut rekia. yekum malka chad rav veshalit bealma, veyitgae rucheh al kol malchin, veyittear keravin bitren sitrin, veyitgabbar alayyhu.

Uveyoma deyitbere (sefer acher deyitkase) kochava, yizdaza ara kaddisha 45 millin, sacharaneh atar dehava be makdesha. umearta chada min techot ara yitgele. umehahi mearta yippuk eshsha takkifa leokda alma. umehahi mearta yisge chad ofa (sefer acher anafa), ravreva illaa, deyishlot bechol alma, veleh ityehiv malchuta. vekaddishe elyonin yitkanneshun gabbeh. ucheden yitgele malka meshicha bechol alma, veleh ityehiv malchuta.

Uvene alma beshaata deyitgele, yehon mishtakkechin beakta batar akta. vesanehon deyisrael yitgabberun, keden yittear rucha dimshicha alayyhu, vishetze leedom chayyayva, vechol ara deshoir yokid benura. keden ketiv, veyisrael ose chayil. hada hu dichtiv, vehaya edom yeresha vehaya yeresha seir oyvav. oyvav deyisrael. ucheden veyisrael ose chayil. uvehahu zimna, yakim kudesha berich hu lemetayyay deammeh, veyitnashe minnehon mita, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:16-17) yemin Adonai osa chayil. lo amut ki echye. uchetiv (Ovadya 1:21) vealu moshiim vegomer. ucheden (Zecharya 14:9) vehaya Adonai lemelech.

Amar ribbi abba, may dichtiv, (yeshaya noah) ki besimcha tetzeu vegomer. ella kad yippekun yisrael min galuta, shechinta nafka immehon, veimah yippekun. hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya noah) ki vesimcha tetzeu. sason da kudesha berich hu. ribbi yitzchak amar da tzaddik. hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya noah) sason vesimcha yimmatze vah.

Amar rabbi shimon, tzaddik sason ikre. umin yoma dikkeneset yisrael naflat begaluta. itmenau birkan millenachta lealma mehay tzaddik. behahu zimna ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 12:3) usheavtem mayim besason, da tzaddik. mimmaayyne hayeshua, illen abba veima. davar acher, illen netzach vehod. vecholla mimmabbue neviin amikin. keden (Yeshayahu 12:1) veamarta bayom hahu odcha Adonai vegomer, (Yeshayahu 12:1) tzahali varonni yoshevet tziyyon vegomer. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen.
1456: (Bamidbar 25:10) vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor, pinchas ben elazar vegomer, ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Mishlei 1:8) shema beni musar avicha veal tittosh torat immecha. (yitro 85 amud alef) shema beni musar avicha, da kudesha berich hu. veal tittosh torat immecha, da keneset yisrael. may musar avicha, musar, da orayyta, deit bah kamma tochachin, kamma onashin. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 3:11) musar Adonai beni al timas veal takotz betochachto.

Uvegin dechol man deishtedal beorayyta behay alma, zache deyiftechun leh kamma tarin lehahu alma, kamma nehorin. beshaata deyinpok mehay alma, hi akdimat kammeh, veazla lechol neture tarin, machrezet veomeret, (Yeshayahu 26:2) pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik. atkinu kurseyayn liflanayya avda demalka. delet chadu lekudesha berich hu ella man deishtedal beorayyta, kol shekken bar nash demitar belelya leishtaddela beorayyta, deha kol tzadikayyay divginta deeden, tzayytin lekalleh, vekudesha berich hu mishtechach benayyhu, kema deukemuha (Shir HaShirim 8:13) hayyoshevet bagannim chaverim makshivim lekolech hashemiini.

Rabbi shimon amar hay kera raza dechachmeta it beh. hayyoshevet bagannim, da keneset yisrael, deihi begaluta im yisrael, veazla immehon beaktayyhu. chaverim makshivim lekolech, mashiryayn illain. kullehu tzayytin lekolech, lekol tushebachtech begaluta. hashemiini, kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 2:14) hareini et marayich hashemiini et kolech. hashemiini, kala deinnun chavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta deha let tushebachta kammay, keinnun demishtaddele beorayyta.

Amar rabbi shimon, kivyachol, kol innun dezakkan leishtaddela beorayyta, umikkad palig lelya, veatyayn bematronita kad nahir yemama, lekabbela anpe malka, atkif veachasin bishchinta. velo od, ella desharya beh chut shel chesed, kema deokimna.

Ta chaze, kol man dezache leittakaf bishchinta, yistemar garmohi meinnun millin daachidan lokovlah. kegon man. innun dela meshakkere beat kadisha, kegon bat el nechar. vechol man denatir garmeh, kivyachol keneset yisrael achida beh, venatra leh, vehi akdimat leh shelam. vekol shekken i zache vekkane lehay.

Veamar rabbi shimon, itchazyayn yisrael leishtetzaa behahu shaata, bar deakdim pinchas lehay ovada, veshachich rugeza. hada hu dichtiv, pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen heshiv vegomer. davar acher, pinchas ben elazar vegomer. amar rabbi shimon, ben ben tere zimne, leashlema ovada (nusach acher ovada) ka ate.

Amar ribbi shimon, hay bar nash denatil gilgula denishmeta, vela zache deyittakkan beh, keillu meshakker bekusheta demalka. vaana karenna aleh hay kera (Vayikra Adonai:22) o matza aveda vechichesh bah venishba al shaker. vechichesh bah, tav leh dela ivre.

Tanenan tzaddik gamur, eno nidche. vetzaddik sheeno gamur, nidche. man hu tzaddik gamur, uman hu tzaddik sheeno gamur, vechi man dela shelim bemilloy, tzaddik ikre. ella, tzaddik gamur, yedia, deha la natil gilgulin akimmin, uveachasante bane binyayn, veatkin shurin, vechatzav berin, venata ilanin.

Tzadik sheeno gamur, devane binyayn beachasanta ochora, chafar bah berin, veadar, ha atkin avne yesoda kemillekaddemin, veamal bah, vela yada i ishtear dileh. missitra dileh, tav vetzadik ikre. umissitra dehahu achasanta, lav hachi.

Lebar nash devane binyayn shepiran, yaan lemecheze, istakkal bisoda, vechame leh shekia akima michol sitrin. ha binyayna la shelim, ad desatar leh, veatkin leh kemillekaddemin. missitra dehahu binyayna dileh, ishtechach tav veshappir.
1457: Missitra diysoda, bish veakim. uvegin kach, la ikre ovada shelim, la ikre binyayna shelim. begin kach tzadik sheeno gamur ikre, venidche. veal da (Chavakuk 1:13) kevalla rasha tzaddik mimmennu.

Ta chaze, man dimkanne lishma kadisha dekudesha berich hu, deafillu la yizche laggedula, vela itchaze lah, (sefer acher deyarit la) ravavch lah venatil lah. veda yarit lah veayil lah. pinchas la itchaze leh behahu zimna, uvegin dekinne lishma demareh, ravavch lecholla, vesalik lecholla, veittakkan beh kolla vezacha leishtammesha bichhuna illaa. mehahi shaata, pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen, deashlim litren dargin, begin dekanne lishma demareh, deittekan ma deitakkam.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 86:2) shamra nafshi ki chasid ani hosha avdecha vegomer. sofeh dikra it leistakkela, ulevatar kera kolla, sofeh dikra ketiv, habboteach elecha, habboteach bach mibbae leh, may habboteach elecha. ella kivyachol david mavtach leh, dela yabar leh palgut lelya beshinta, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 119:62) chatzot layla akum lehodot lach. kamti mibbae leh. ella, akum, veetkeshar bach lealmin.

Shamra nafshi, shemor mibbae leh. veha tanenan delet at beorayyta dela it bah razin illain veyakkirin. shamra. lekudesha berich hu kaamar, shamra lehahu chulaka, deitachad beh nefesh. dechad nafsha nafkat mehay alma, atya lemerat alma (deate). i zache, kama chelin illain nafkin lokovla, ulenatra lah, uleaala lah bemadora deduchetaha, vehay Adonai natil lah, leitachada immah beresh yarche veshabbatte.

Vei la zache, kama gardine tehirin izdammenan lokovlah, vedachu lah levar. vavy lehahi nafsha, demitgalgela berekanayya, keavna bekusefita. hada hu dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 25:29) veet nefesh oyvecha yekalenna betoch kaf hakkala. vedavid bae bauteh kamme kudesha berich hu veamar, shamra nafshi, dela yidchun lah levar. vechad mate (sefer acher lokovlach, ypetachevan lecha) lokovlah, yiftechun lah pitchin, utekabbel lah kammach. ki chasid ani, vechi chasid ikre. amar ribbi yehuda, in. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 55:3) chasde david hanneemanim. begin kach shamra nafshi, dela tishbok lah lemehach levar.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, kol bar nash deit leh chulaka betzaddik, yarit lehay eretz, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim vegomer. vehay tzadik chasid ikre. amar david batar divhay atar achidna, chasid ani, uvegin kach shamra nafshi, leitkashshera bach.

Ribbi chiyyay patach, (Tehillim 81:6) edut bihosef samo vegomer. ha okmuha, deolif shivin pitkin, velashon hakkodesh yatir. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 81:6) sefat lo yadati eshma. aval may edut. ta chaze, beshaata deitteteh defotifar havat achida beh lehahi milla, hava yosef avid garmeh keman dela yada lishana dilah, vechen bechol yoma ad hahi shaata batrayyta, dichtiv (Bereshit 39:12) vattitpesehu bevigdo. may vattitpesehu. ella begin deavid garmeh keman dela yada lishana. veruach hakkodesh tzavavch lokovleh, (Mishlei 7:Adonai) lishmarcha meisha zara minnachriyya amareha hecholika. may ka mashma lan. ella kol man denatir garmeh mehay, itkeshar bah bishchinta, veachid behahu edut. umay hu. Adonai deittosaf beh. dichtiv, edut bihosef samo. uf hacha 10 ittosaf befinchas, al dekanne behay.

Ribbi yesa patach, (Tehillim 137:1) al naharot bavel sham yashavnu gam bachinu bezachrenu et tziyyon. et yerushalam mibbae leh, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 137:1) im eshkachech yerushala 40 tishkach yemini, may bezachrenu et tziyyon. lebar nash dehava leh hechala yakira, yaa veshappira, atu listin veokidu leh. tzaara deman hu, lav demareh dehechala. uf hacha shechinta begaluta sharya, tzaara deman hu, lav detzaddik. veazla ha kema deukemuha, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad, avad mammash. uf hacha bezachrenu et tziyyon, bezachrenu hahu tzaara dileh al ziuugaha, tzaara dileh hu.

Amar ribbi yesa, man deokir shema demareh behay, venatir hay, zacha deyokir leh mareh al kolla. menalan. miyyosef. dichtiv, (Bereshit 41:43) vayyarkev oto bemirkevet hammishne asher lo, uchetiv venaton oto al kol eretz mitzrayim
1458: Velo od, ella kad avru yisrael yat yamma, arona deyosef al bego bekadmita, vela havo mayya kayymin al kiumayyhu kammeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 114:3) hayyam raa vayyanos. may vayyanos. ella raa hahu dichtiv beh (Bereshit 39:12) vayyanas vayyetze hachutza.

Ta chaze, zache likara bechayyyoy vezache likara bemitateh. bechayav amay. begin hahu zeman dela baa leitdabbeka bah, dichtiv, (Bereshit 39:10) vaymaen vayyomer el eshet adonav. uchetiv velo shama eleha lishkav etzlah lihyot immah. begin kach zacha behay alma. kevan dichtiv vattitpesehu bevigdo, uchetiv vayanas vayyetze hachutza, zache levatar deal lego parochta illaa, vehachi itchaze leh, dideh natal behay alma, vedideh natal bealma achara.

Pinchas zache behay alma, vezacha bealma deate, vezacha lekayyeyma yatir mikkol innun denafku mimmitzrayim, vezacha lechahana illaa, hu vechol benoy abbatreh. vei tema dela (nusach acher deha) zacha lechahana ad la aved ovada da. in (sefer acher lo). deha innun deamre (dela) dezacha kodem. lav hachi ella bemay okimna tachat asher kinne lelohav, demashma divgin ovada da ravavch kehunata, ma dela hava kodem.

Ta chaze, kol kohen dekatil nefesh, pasil leh kehunateh lealmin. deha vadday pasil hahu darga dileh legabbeh. ufinchas min dina pasil lechahana hava, uvegin dekanne leh lekudesha berich hu, itzterich leyachasa leh kehunat almin, leh, velivnoy abbatreh, ledare darin. amar ribbi yitzchak, ta chaze, rashim hu pinchas leella, verashim hu letatta, ad la yippuk lealma deha im innun denafku mimmitzrayim itmene.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose veribbi chiyyay, havo azle bemadbera, amar ribbi yose, ha dichtiv befinchas hinni noten lo et beriti shalom. shalom mimmalach hammavt, dela shallit beh lealmin, vela itdan bedinoy. vei tema dela mit. vadday la mit kishar bene alma, veorich yomin al kol bene dara, begin divhay berit illaa achid, vechad istellak mealma, betiuveta illaa uvidvikuteh shappira istallak mishshear bene alma.

Ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Zecharya 3:1) vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol omed lifne malach Adonai vegomer. ta chaze, vavy leinnun bene nasha, dela mistakkelan bikara demarehon, vechol yoma veyoma karoza kare alayyhu, vela mashgichin. ata bar nash leistakkela befikkude orayyta, kama sannegorin kayymin leadkera aleh letav. ata bar nash veabar al pikkude orayyta, innun ovadin kategorin aleh levish, kamme kudesha berich hu. yehoshua kohen gadol hava, veokmuha, ma ketiv beh. vehassatan omed al yemino lesitno. uma behay kach, bishar bene alma dela mistakkele bikara demarehon, al achat kamma vechamma.

Chame ma ketiv, vihoshua haya lavush begadim tzoim, veokmuha. aval begadim tzoim, vadday innun levushin deitlabbesha beh rucha behahu alma. zakkaa chulakeh deman dilvushoy mittakkenin ushelemin behahu alma. veha ittemar, kol man devayayn leaala lagehinam, innun levushin dimlabbeshin leh, hech innun. ma ketiv hacha, vihoshua haya lavush begadim tzoim veomed lifne hammalach. man malach. da malach dimmana al gehinnam, umemana al man dechame beinnun levushin. ad deativ kala veamar, hasiru habbegadim hatztzoim mealav.

Mehacha it leistakkela, deovadin bishin debar nash, avdin leh innun levushim tzoim. vayyomer elav ree heevarti mealecha avonecha vehalebesh otcha machalatzot. albishineh levushin acharanin metutkenan, divhu istakkal bar nash beziv yekara demareh.
Ta chaze, kegavvna da pinchas, dela istallak mealma, ad deittekanu kammeh levushin acharanin, derucha ithane behu, lealma
1459: Deate. beshaata chada itpeshshat meillen. veitlebash beillen, lekayyeyma dichtiv hinni noten lo et beriti shalom. ad dahavo azle, shimsha hava takkifa, veyatvu techot tzilla dechad tinara demadbera. amar ribbi elazar, vadday tzilla chedvavta denafsha hu.

Amar ribbi chiyyay leribbi elazar, illen yomin, merosh hashshana ad yoma batraa dechag, baena lemekam alayyhu. amar ribbi elazar, ha ittemar vechavrayyay itaru behu. amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday hachi hu, aval ana shemana levutzina kadisha illaa milla behu. amar leh, ema hahu milla. amar leh ad la kaimna beh. amar ribbi elazar, af al gav dechavrayyay okmu milla, veshappir hu, aval siddura dehane yome, raza dechachmeta hu, ben mechatztzede chakla.

Ta chaze, ha ittemar siddura deyichuda kolla bechad hech havi. veha ittemar. patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 52:10) chasaf Adonai et zeroa kadsho, da deroa chada, deveh talya yeshua, deveh talya nukema, deveh talya purekana. velamma, lemekam lah lechneset yisrael meafra, ulekabbela lah legabbeh, leizdavvevga kachada. vechad hay itar lekabbelah, kama dechilu sharya bealma, ad deyanach hahu deroa techot reshaha leitchabbera. kema deat amar, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi vegomer, ucheden nayycha dina, umechapper chovin.

Levatar ate yemina lechabbeka, keden chedvavta sharyay bealma, vechol anpin nehirin. levatar izdavvevgat begufa, ucheden kolla ikre echad, bela piruda, keden hu shelimu decholla, vechedvavta decholla, veachidu vday, ma dela ishtechach hachi bishar zimne.

Kegavvna dehay, siddura dehane yomin, merosh hashshana ad yoma batraa dechag. berosh hashshana, itar deroa dismala, lekabbela lah lematronita, ucheden kol alma bidchilu bedina, uvae hahu zimna betiyyuveta shelim, leishtachcha alma kamme kudesha berich hu. levatar atiat matronita, uvayayn bene hechala betisha leyarcha, lemebad chedvavta, ulemitbal benahara, ledacha garmayyhu bezivuga dematronita, beyoma achara, hu ziuuga dilah leshavvava semala techot reshaha, (nusach acher resha demalka) kema deat amar semolo tachat leroshi.

Ucheden yisrael betaanita al chovayyhu, umechappera lehu. deha imma illaa anhirat anpaha lematronita beziuugaha, umitkapperin kol bene hechala. kevan dismala mekabbelah lah behay yoma, deresha dematronita sharyay al semala.

Beyoma kadmaa dechag, yitar yemina lekabbelah, begin lechabbeka ucheden kol chedvav vechol anpin nehirin, vechedvavta demayim tzelilan, lenassecha al madbecha. uvayayn bene nasha lemechede bechol zinin dechedva, deha yemina garim. bechol atar deshari yemina, chedvavta itzterich becholla, keden chedvavta hi leishtashea.

Levatar beyoma teminaa, chedvavta deorayyta hu, deha keden ziuuga degufa, hu ziuuga decholla, lemehevi kolla chad, veda hu shelimu decholla, veda yoma deyisrael ihu vadday, veadva didhu bilchodayyhu, delet beh chulaka leachara. zakkain innun yisrael bealma den, uvealma deate, alayyhu ketiv (Devarim 14:2) ki am kadosh atta laAdonai elohecha vegomer.

(Bamidbar 25:11) pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen heshiv et chamati meal bene yisrael vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach, (Iyov 4:7) zechar na mi hu naki avad veefo yesharim nichchadu, tamman tanenan, man dechame keshet bigvavnoy (sefer acher naharin), itzterich levarcha baruch zocher habberit. begin deda ihu berit kayyeyma kadisha, deshavvi kudesha berich hu
1460: Beara dela yete alah me tofana. begin dechad segiu chayyayvin bealma, bae kudesha berich hu leovada lon, ucheden dachir lon hay omaa deome leara, dichtiv tere zimne lo lo. (Bereshit 8:21) lo osif lekallel, velo osif od lehakkot, da ihu omaa. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:9) asher nishbati meavor me noach. (kashur im hareaya mehemana)

Ribbi yose amar, keshet ata leaggana al alma. lemalka, dechol zimnin divreh chav lokovleh, ata malka lealkaa leh, itgalya aleh matronita bilvushe yekar demalchu, malka chame lah salik rugeza divreh, vechade bah, dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:16) ureitiha lizkor berit olam. veal da, la itchaze keshet bealma, ella bilvushe yekar demalchu. uveshaata deit tzaddik bealma, ihu berit, lemekam berit, veagin al alma. la havi tzaddik, ha keshet, leitchazaa deha alma ihu kayyeyma leovada, ella begin keshet da. ribbi elazar amar, leolam la itlebash keshet da, ella bilvusha daavahan kadmae. yarok vesumak vechivvavr. yeroka, da levusha deavraham, itzteba levusha (sefer acher gon) da, kad nafak minneh yishmael. sumaka, da gon yitzchak. deatya sumaka veitzteba, kad nafik minneh esav. veitmeshach hahu sumaka letatta, ad kochava demadim, deitachid beh esav. chivvavra, da ihu levusha tava deyaakov, deha la ishtannu anpohi lealmin. ribbi abba amar yaut hu, aval hachi amar butzina kadisha, chivvavr, da avraham. deitlabban bechivvavra denura. sumaka, da yitzchak vaday. yarok, da hu yaakov, dekayyeyma ben teren gavvnin, uchetiv beh beyaakov, (Yeshayahu 29:22) lo atta yevosh yaakov velo atta panav yechovaru deha kol arseh shelim hava. vehachi hu lo atta yevosh yaakov, leitchazaa begavvn sumak, keyitzchak denafak minneh esav. vela atta panav yechovaru, keavraham leitchazaa begavvn chivvavr, denafak minneh yishmael. ella natal gavvnin, leitattera behu, al avahan dileh,

Raya mehemna amar leh raya mehemana, shappir kaamrat, aval begin deeliyyahu deihu pinchas, kanne al berit, tzarich lechadta millin sagiin beh, dehay parsheta ketiva beorayyta al shemeh, dealeh ittemar (Melachim 1 19:10) kanno kinneti, tere kenaot, chad beshadday dilella, vetinyayna beshadday diltatta, uvegin da avid teren shevuot (nusach acher bitren lo lo) (sefer acher bitren zimnin) betarvavyyhu, uteren zimnin lo lo.

Aval ribbi yehuda amar, man dechame keshet bigvavnoy nehirin, tzarich levarcha baruch zocher habberit. uvegaluta delav ihu nahir bigvavnoy kedka yeot, velo od ella dilzimnin nahir zeer, vezimnin la nahir kelal, zimnin itchazi bishlimu, vezimnin lav. dekeshet ka ramiz gevavnoy, lezachvavn dechohanim leviyyim veyisreelim, kad innun shappirin, denahir keshet begvavnoy deinnun telat.

Kum ant ribbi yose hagalili, veema, deha millin shepirin kaamrat bechibbura kadmaa, dekeshet la atya ella leaggana al alma. lemalka, divchol zimna divreh chav, umalka chaze lematronita, salik rugeza divreh, dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:16) ureitiha lizkor berit olam. veal da la itchazi keshet, ella leaggana al alma. vela itgalya, ella bilvush yekar demalchu, uveshaata deit tzadik beara, ihu berit. lemekam berit.

Vechi begaluta, kudesha berich hu itrechak mimmatronita, veech matronita itlabbeshat levushe malchuta begaluta (sefer acher 33 lo) lo. aval begaluta, levushah dekadrut, veihu amrat (Shir HaShirim 1:6) al tiruni sheani shecharchoret. ella vadday hahu keshet deitgalyay begaluta, lav ihu ella metatron, deitkere shadday veihu (Bereshit 24:2) avdo zekan beto, deshallit bechol dileh (begaluta), uvenoy, itkeriu avadim dekudesha berich hu. uvene matronita banim, uvegin da, im kevanim im kaavadim.

Uvezimna deitcharav be makdesha, ukemuha daavadim chafu rosham, venitdaldelu anshe maase. vadday anshe maase itkeriu, al shem matronita, deittemar alah (Mishlei 31:29) rabbot banot asu chayil veat alit al kullana. aval i it leh tzadik, dezachvoy
1461: Uveillen levushin mitlabbeshat keshet, beshaata deitchaze kamme malka. ta chaze, raza divrit kaddisha, hi at yod, demitattera birshimu illaa, veha (sefer acher veda) ihu deitreshim bivrit tadir lealmin, uvegin dekanne pinchas al berit, itreshim bishmeh hacha at da, pinchas yod zeera, ihu yod deihu berit vadday, denafik migo yod illaa kadisha. veal da, ihu kaim bekiyyuma shelim kamme malka kadisha, dela itavid miggo alma. vehachi hu naki mehahu chova difor, vela itavid tadir miggo kadisha dealma. (sefer acher velo itavid miggo alma) (Iyov 4:7) veefo yesharim nichchadu, illen nadav vaavihu, dela ishtetziu min hahu alma begineh.

Veovadoy leanhara, behon matronita, ulemifshat minnah levushe kadruta difshatin ulekashta lah bilvushin digvavnin nehirin derazin deorayyta, ma ketiv beh, ureitiha lizkor berit olam. ureitiha, berazin nehirin deorayyta, deor raz itkere, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 6:23) ki ner mitztzeva tora or. uveillen razin ittemar ureitiha.

Uvehahu zimna salik minneh rugeza divreh, (Ester 7:10) vachamat hammelech shachacha, veyemma lah malka bitztzelota daamida kammeh, (Ester Adonai:6) ma sheelatech veyyinaten lach uma bakkashatech. behahu zimna, sheelta al purekana dilah, uvenaha immeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Ester 7:3) tinnaten li nafshi bishelati veammi bevakkashati. aval keshet deitchazya bealma begaluta, deavda ihu, zimnin denafik bishlimu, kad benoy machshirin ovadoy, ulezimnin la ishtechach bishlimu, kad benoy la machsherin ovadoy (kan chaser). vei lav begin ot yod deshadday dekanni alah pinchas deagin leh mishivta deshimon havu katlin leh veovdin leh mealma.
