Uvegin da (Iyov 4:7) zechor na mi hu naki avad da pinchas veefo yesharim nichchadu, illen dimchashrin ovadehon kamme malka, umekannin al shemeh, umakdishin leh barabbim. hachi mekadshin leh leella, ben memanan dishar ammin, veishtemodin leh kol memana bechinuyeh. aval yisrael ishtemodin leella kolla beshem Adonai, deihu chayye kol kinnuyin.

Vechol shem vechinnuy sahid aleh, el sahid aleh, deit leh yecholet al kol el, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov Adonai:8) ani edrosh el el. el, mare deel. elohim sahid aleh, deihu elohe haelohim. adonay sahid aleh, deihu adone haadonim. uf hachi kol shem. dechol (sefira umalach) malach it lechol chad shem yedia, leishtemoda lechol kat behahu shem demalka dileh. aval yisrael, ishtemodan leh 28.

Veraza demilla, bar nash chad yachil lemehevi leh kama susevavn, uf hachi kol yisrael innun benoy deadam, vechol bera tzarich lemehevi leh laavuy kassus vechachamor lemasuy, ulemehevi kafif techotoy, vehay ihu raza (Tehillim 36:7) adam uvehema toshia Adonai. deihu bera deadam, veavid garmeh kavhema techotoy.

Uvegin da ihu pikkuda dekudesha berich hu beorayyta, lemehevi ach meyabbem leitteteh deach, lemebad bera laachuy, begin dela yitavid mehahu alma. vehay ihu kegon raza dechilayim betztzitztzit. deamru, ma sheasarti lach kan, hettarti lach kan. asarti lach kilayim dealma, hettarti lach kilayim detztzitztzit. asarti lach eshet ach, hettarti lach yevama. kegon marchivim tappuchim o dekallim min bemino. veasur learkava min besheeno mino. veittemar beh (Devarim 20:19) ki haadam etz hassade. uvayyevama markivin min besheeno mino, (Tikkunim 19 amud alef 370) begin dela litavid (lehaavid) nefesh hammet. (Devarim 25:6) velo yimmache shemo miyyisrael.

Vehay ihu raza degilgul. galgal let leh tenua bela amat hammayim, uf hachi, amat hammayim raza deat 6, beh itavid galgal gilgul. veraza demilla, ma galgal en lo tenua bela amat hammayim, uf hachi, galgal ihu 10, velet leh tenua bela amat hammayim deihu 6. yevama Adonai. lehay ihu bina ben yah. beot 10 bara alma deate, olam aroch, deihu 6.

Begin da, man delet le ben, lav ihu mibbene alma deate, deyamma lokovleh, uminneh nafik, mibbenayyhu (Tikkunim amud bet amud alef) 6, uminneh mitpallegin kama nachale, deinnun mesabbevin alma, ad dechazru leyamma denafku mittamman, uvegin da amar kera, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam enennu male el mekom shehannechalim vegomer. ad deahadru kegavvna denafku.
Uf hachi, (Kohelet 12:7) veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah. kegavvna deyahiv lah
1462: Shelemata. im tashuv betiyyuveta, deihu bina ben yah, illaa. at Adonai selikat beat 10 lechamshin, eser zimnin chamesh. ha ihu yam, yah. ben, nachal denafak min yamma, veitpelig lechamma nachalin, kegavvna deilana deitfeshat lechamma anpin.

Vei la chazar nishmeta shelemata, kegavvna deishtelamat. ittemar bah, sham hem shavim lalachet, ihi vechol nishmatin acharanin. uf hachi lav ihu shelim beven, i let leh bat, deihu alma den, lemehevi shelim behay alma deitbere baAdonai, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram. (ella)

Yahu, (Iyov 33:29) hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver. verashshiayyay deittemar behon, (Kohelet 8:10) uvechen raiti reshaim kevurim vavau, garmu elle elohecha yisrael, deittemar alayyhu, (Amos 2:6) al shelosha pishe yisrael. batar dekilkelu garmayyhu telat zimnin, vela zache beyhv, deittemar beh (Kohelet 11:3) mekom sheyyippol haetz sham yehu. al arbaa lo ashivennu, dehayynu Adonai. veitdanu bagehinnam, bemashchit af vechema.

Ulevushin ditlat atvavn illen, ishtemodin bakkeshet, deinnun chivvavr sumak veyarok. man deyite bezimna chada, ihu chivvavr. betinyayna, sumak. bitlitaa, yarok. uvegin divyaakov itkelilu atvavn, veishterash ilana veitneta veitrabba, veitavid ibba tava, (Yeshayahu 29:22) lo atta yevosh yaakov velo atta panav yechevaru, lemehevi merkavteh beyitztzer hara, deihu nachash, vechol mine chayya bisha. uvegin da, (Hoshea 12:5) vayyasar el malach vayuchol. uvegin deitkere adam ilana, ihu raza da, leilana deitnata baatar dela avid ibba. me aved. akar leh unetaeh baatar achara. uvegin da ukemuha mikkol makom dela havi muchezak lemehevi akar, ad deazil leeretz yisrael, veitneta tamman beitteta.

Uf hachi tzadik, deihu mitaltel meatar leatar, mibbayit levayit, keillu yete begilgula zimnin saggiin. vehayeynu (Shemot 20:6) veose chesed laalafim leohavav, ad deyizke lealma (deate) shelim. aval lechayyayvayya, la ayyte leh yatir mittelat zimnin. vei chazar betiyyuveta, ittemar beh galut mechapperet avon. uvegin da okmuha mare matnitin, tzadikim shuv enan chozrim laafaram.

Ella ka ramiz, (Vayikra 14:42) veafar acher yikkach vetach et habbayit. (Iyov 34:15) veadam al afar yashuv. (Kohelet 12:7) veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya. begin dehu menuga, velet beh ella isha raa, yetztzer hara, deittemar bah isha raa tzaraat levalah. may takanteh. yegarshenna veyitrappe. deihi garmat (Bereshit 3:24) vaygaresh et haadam haadam, da nishmeta. et, bat zugo deadam. (Mishlei 27:8) ketztzippor nodedet min kinnah ken ish noded mimmekomo.

Uvegin da, (Tehillim 84:4) gam tzippor matztzea vayit, hayeynu yevama. uderor ken lah, hayeynu goel, asher shata efrocheha, ben uvat. zakkaa ihu man deavad (lon) kinna, (Vayikra 25:25) vegaal et mimkar achiv. deihu machur baavur delav dileh.

Uvegin da amar moshe, (Devarim 3:26) vayitabber Adonai bi lemaanchem. hacha hu sod haibbur. raya mehemana, sheziv shittin ribbo, kamma zimnin deate begilgula, uvegin da zechut kullehu talyay kudesha berich hu beh. uvegin da okmuha rabbanan, ishsha achat yalda bemitztzerayim shishshim ribbo becheres echad. veaf al gav deokmuha rabbanan bemillin acharanin, shivim panim lattora.

Dehachi orach demare razin, amrin margalit letalmidehon, vela ishtemodun beh birmiza, ahdar lon hahu milla bemille sechok, kegavvna dehahu deamar, devetztza achat, appilat shittin kerachin. veata betztza venaflat min ofa dehava parach baavira, umachaat illen shittin kerachin, umare deletztzanuta amru, dela amar hu ella debar nash katav shishshim kerachin, veata betztza denafkat min ofa umechakat shitin kerachin dichtiva. vechas veshalom demare orayyta amrin millin dischok, udevarim betelim beorayyta.

Ella ha okmuha, (Devarim 22) efrochim, illen mare mishna. o betztzim, illen mare mikra. uchegavvna denafal mehahu nippol, deihu bar nafle, nefilat betztza deihu etrog shiura bechabbetztza. uveginah ittemar (Amos 9:11) bayom hahu akim et sukkat david hannofelet. venaflu immah (Shir HaShirim 6:8) shishshim hemma melachot, deinnun kerichin bah, kegon ketztzad korchin et shema. veinnun lokovel shishshim massechtot. vaalamot en mispar, illen (Tehillim 45:15) betulot achareha reoteha, deinnun halachot, delet lon chusheban.

Vehahu nippol ihu ben yah ihu betoch 50 tarin devina, dehayynu yah chamesh zimnin eser 6 ihu nippol, denafal batar hahi deittemar, (Yeshayahu 14:12) ech nafalta mishshamayim hellel ben shachar veikre nippol, velo nafal, velo nofel. begin deveh nippol 16 venachit behon legabbe Adonai Adonai, deittemar behon (Rut 1:19) vattelachna shetehen. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 22:7) shallech teshallach chad mibbayit rishon vetinyayna mibbayit sheni, leakama lon. hada hu dichtiv,
1463: Ta chazi, hay shimsha itgalya bimama, veitkasya belelya. venahir beshittin ribbo kochavayya. uf hachi raya mehemana, batar deitkenish mealma, nahir beshittin ribbo nishmatin deyisrael, i dara kaddeka yaut. vehay ihu raza degilgula, deamar aleh kohelet, (Kohelet 1:4) dor holech vedor ba. veokmuha delet dor pachut mishshishim ribbo. vehaaretz leolam omedet, da keneset yisrael. hahi deittemar bah, (Yeshayahu 66:1) vehaaretz hadom raglay, (Bereshit 28:14) vehaya zaracha kaafar haaretz.

Veod raza achara okmuha rabbanan, hador sheholech hu hador shebba, halach chiger ba chiger, holech suma ba suma. veod okmuha rabbanan, deatid hava moshe lekabbela orayyta bedara detofana, ella begin dahavo rashiayyay, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 6:3) beshaggam hu basar. beshaggam ze moshe. vaamay kare leh beshaggam. ella kohelet chisser 2 min beshaggam lechassaa milla. amar (Kohelet 8:14) amarti sheggam ze havel.

Veokmuha al yitro, lamma nikra shemo keni, shennifrad mikkayin. kam butztzina kadisha veamar, al da ketiv, (Bereshit 4:1) kaniti ish et Adonai. dechazaat leh beruach hakkodesh, daatidin benoy lemetav belishkat haggazit.

Veof hachi ribbi elazar ben pedat, dehava dechika leh shaata, dela hava leh ella kav charuvin meerev shabbat leerev shabbat, kemo leribbi chanina. amay hay, batar dahavat bat kol nafkat veomeret, kol haolam kullo eno nizon ella bishvil chanina beni.

Ella ihu garim kodem, decharav 102 min 10, deihu yabbok. uf hachi la hava leh ella kav charuvin. deat 10 ihu yichud, uminneh atya neviu leat 2, deihi beracha, veihi kodesh, uminneh itkaddash 100, deihi kidushe. veribbi pedat garim lemehevi charuvin dileh 102, deinnun kedusha beracha, uf hachi la hava leh ella kav charuvin, uf hachi iyyov ben yevama hava, uvegin da itannash, al ma deira lo kevar.

Veinnun dela yade raza da, amre bene chayye umezone lav bizchuta talya milleta, ella bemazzala talya milleta. veha chazena leavraham dechaza bemazzaleh, dela hava atid lemehevi leh bera, vekudesha berich hu appik leh levara, kedichtiv (Bereshit 15:5) vayyotztze oto hachutztza vayymer habbet vegomer. veakmuha, deamar leh tze meitztzetagninut shellach, veheelahu lemala mehakkochavim, veamar lo habbet na hashshamayma usefor hakkochavim. ad hacha millin derabbanan, vetztzarich lefarsha lon bederech nistar.

Ta chaze, kol biryayn dealma, kodem deityeyhivat orayyta leyisrael, havo talyayn bemazzala, vaafillu bene chayyi umezone. aval batar deityeyhivat orayyta leyisrael, appik lon mechiyyuva dechochavayya umazzale. veda olifna meavraham. begin dahavo atidin benoy lekabbela Adonai meavraham, deihi chamishsha chumashe tora. deittemar bah (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, baAdonai beraam. amar leavraham, begin hay Adonai deitosaf bishmach, hashshamayim tachtach, vechol kochavaya umazzale dinhirin baAdonai. velo od, ella deittemar bah (Bereshit 47:23) hei lachem zera, uzeratem beHei. (Bereshit 21:12) ki beyitztzechak yikkare lecha zara.

Uvegin da, kol hamishtaddel beorayyta, batil minneh chiuva dechochavayya umazzale. i olif lah kede lekayyeyma pikkudaha. veim lav, keillu la ishtedal bah, vela batil minneh chiuva dechochavayya umazzale. kol shekken amme haaretz deinnun itmatlan liviran. deokmuha alayyhu (Devarim 27:21) arur shochev im kol behema, dela itbatlun minnehon chiuva dechochavayya umazzale.

(Tehillim 103:15) enosh kechatztzir yamav ketztzitz hassade ken yatztzitz, veittemar beh, (Tehillim 37:25) naar hayiti gam zakanti. levatar (Iyov 33:25) yashuv lime alumav. deilana deitketztzitztzu anfin attikin dileh, vetztzamchu kemillekaddemin besharshoy, ahadru bealma kemillekaddemin. mitu savin, veithadru lehay alma uleymin. vehayeynu raza dimchaddesh kudesha berich hu bechol yom tamid maase vereshit. demetin elef bechol yoma umitchaddeshin elef bechol yoma.

(Tehillim 104:15) veyayin yesammach levav enosh, da yina deorayyta. dehachi salik yayin, kechusheban sod. uma yayin tzarich lemehevi satim vechatim, dela yitnessach leavoda zara. uf hachi tzarich lemehevi satim vechatim sod deorayyta, vechol razin dilah, vela ishtakyayn ella lireav. velav lemagana avdin kamma pikudin bayayin, umevarchin beh lekudesha berich hu, veyayin it leh tere gavvnin, chivvar vesumak, dina verachame, vehayeynu 2 tosefet bayayin. kegavvna deshoshanna chivvara vesumaka. chivvavr missitra dimina, sumak missitra dismala.

Umay levav enosh, lev hava leh lememar. ella it lev masur lallev. veinnun 32 elohim deovada divreshit, 2 min bereshit, 30 min leene kol yisrael, ihu 32 tinyayna. da lev lev (sefer acher inun) shenayim salleka datach, chasar temanya lev, deihu vaychullu. innun shiva yeme bereshit. teminaa may hi. 7 yeme bereshit, im (Bereshit Adonai:1) ze sefer toldot adam. ze amud bet, bechushevan beyayin.
May lehatztzehil panim mishshamen. innun 12 panim, 4 dearyi, 4 deshor, 4 denesher,
1464: Deinnun michael aryi, arba anpin dileh Adonai. arba anpin deshor, veihu gavriel, veinnun Adonai. 4 anpin denesher, veihu nuriel, veinnun Adonai. veinnun memanan, techot chesed pachad emet, dargin ditlat avahan. veokmuha rabbanan, haavot hen hen hamerkava. vesallekin (sefer acher nekudin) nehorin lechushban yabbok. veinnun melech malach yimloch, Adonai ehye adonay. sach hakkol yabbok (rabbi abba verabbi yose 374 shayych kan).

Ribbi shimon hava yativ velae befarsheta da, ata lekammeh ribbi elazar bereh, amar leh, nadav vaavihu may avidtayyhu befinchas. i la hava pinchas bealma kad mitu, uvatar ata lealma veashlim duchetayyhu shappir. aval pinchas bealma hava, (sefer acher vasegan kae) venishmateh beh bekiyyuma kae.

Amar leh beri, raza illaa hacha, vehachi hu. divshaata deistalaku min alma, la havo mittammeran techot gadpe tinara kadisha. may tama. begin dichtiv, (Bamidbar 3) uvanim lo hayu lahem, deaziru diyyukena demalka, deha innun la itchazun leshammesha bichhuna rabba.

Beshaata dekanne pinchas al berit kadisha, veal bego kama uchelosin, vesalik lon, legayifin al rumecha, leenehon dechol yisrael. kad chama shivta deshimon bechamma uchlusin deatu legaveh, parcha nishmateh minneh, uteren nishmatin dahavo artirain bela ducheta, itkerivu bah, veitkelilu kachada, veithadderat nishmateh, kelila rucha, deitchelil bitren ruchin, veittakafu beh, keden ravavch duchetayyhu, lemehevi kahana (Rava) ma dela (itchaze) min kadmat dena.

Veal da ketiv, (Iyov 4:7) zechar na mi hu naki avad, dela itavid behahi shaata, vela avid rucheh kad parcha minneh. veefo yesharim nichchadu. illen bene aharon, deithadru lealma, ma deavad bechayyihon. veal da ketiv beh befinchas ben ben, tere zimne. pinchas ben elazar ben.

Ma ketiv leella mipparashta da. (Bamidbar 25:4) vayymer Adonai el moshe kach et kol rashe haam vehoka otam laAdonai neged hashshamesh. vechi al dekatlin belelya, o al dekatlin bimama beyoma deiva, ketiv neged hashshamesh. amar ribbi yehuda, dethe mitathon beitgalyay, kema dechavu beitgalyay.

Amar ribbi shimon, lav begin kach ittemar. ella mehacha olifna, bedarga dechav bar nash lekudesha berich hu, lehahu atar itztzetrich lemebad tekanta lenafsheh. innun chavu bivrit kadisha deikre shemesh. begin kach dina vetikkuna dilhon ihu keneged hashshemesh, velav baatar achara. mikkan dela itztzetrich bar nash letakkena nafsheh, ella behahu atar dechav legaveh uman dela yabid hachi, let leh tikkuna lealmin kaddeka yaut.

Ribbi chiyyay patach, (Tehillim 104:16) yisbeu atztze Adonai arze levanon asher nata, ma ketiv leella, veyayin yesammach levav enosh vegomer. vechi may hay lehay. ella hachi olifna, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:15) (Bereshit 18 amud bet) matztzemiach chatztzir labbehema vegomer. vechi shevacha divhema deit lah chatztzir ata david lememar beruach kudesha. ella matztzemiach chatztzir, illen innun shittin elef ribbo demalachin, shelichan, deitberiu beyoma tinyayna divreshit, vechullehu eshsha melahata. illen innun chatztzir. amay chatztzir. begin detztzamchin kechatztzir da bealma, dechol yoma veyoma itketztziru hasheta, ulevatar tzamchin umehadderin kemillekaddemin.

Veal da ketiv matztzemiach chatztzir labbehema, hada hu dichtiv (Mishlei 12:10) yodea tzaddik nefesh behemto, vetanenan, elef turin sallekin lah bechol yoma veyoma. vechol tura vetura shittin ribbo havi, vehi achla.

Veesev laavodat haadam, illen innun nishmathon detztzaddikayyay, dehahu adam derachiv veshalit al behema da achil, veail lon begavvivy, uvizchutehon ittezan kol alma mehahu adam, dichtiv beh, (Yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam vegomer. veal da ketiv haadam, hahu deishtemoda, begin lehotztzi lechem min haaretz, leappaka mezona lealma min haaretz kaddisha.
Veyayin, da chamra attika denagid milella. yesammach levav enosh, enosh: da raza dehahu naar,
1465: Desalik lesivu, veithaddar kemillekaddemin. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 103:15) enosh kechatztzir yamav.

Raya mehemna amar kudesha berich hu, ushechinti ana shuttafuta denishmeta, vaavoy veimmeh shuttafuta degufa, daavoy mazria loven, deayynin, udegarmin, vegidin, umocha. veitteta shechor deayynin, vesaara, uvisra, umishcha. veof hachi shemayay veara. vechol chayyaylin dilhon, ishtetafu bitztzirateh. malachin, minnehon yetztzer hatov veyitztzer hara lemehevi metztzuyayr mittarvavyyhu. shimsha vesihara, leanhara leh bimama velelya. chevan uveiran veofin venunin, leitparnesa minnehon. kol ilanin vezarin deara, leitparnesa minnehon.
Ma avad kudesha berich hu, akar laavuy uleimmeh migginta deeden, veayyte lehu immeh, lemehevi
1470: Shattif lekudesha berich hu lechedvav dileh, kudesha berich hu ate leginta deeden, veakar mittamman (sefer acher deoda tamman) laavuhi veimmeh, deinnun shuttafin bahadeh, veayyte lon immeh lehahu chedvav, vechullehu zeminin tamman, uvene nasha la yadin. aval beaku debar nash, kudesha berich hu zammin legabbeh bilchodoy, vela oda laavuhi uleimmeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 18:7) batztzar li ekra Adonai veel elohay ashavvia vegomer.

Immeh bechedva divnoy, velet chedva kechedva defurekana, dichtiv bah, (divrei hayamim 1 16:31) yismechu hashshamayim vetagel haaretz vayymru vaggoyim Adonai malach. (divrei hayamim 1 16:33) az yerannenu atztze hayyaar milifne Adonai ki va lishpot et haaretz. (ad kan raya mehemana)

Ahdar hahu tula demilkaddemin, veazla go beta, kemo diyyukena debar nash. nafal al anpoy ribbi abba. amar ribbi yose, adkarna divhay atra chamena leh leribbi pinchas ben yair, yoma chad hava kaim behay ducheta, vahava amar hachi, (Bamidbar 22) pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen, beat 10 zeera.

Begin ditren alfin betin reshimin, alfa beta deatvavn ravrevan, vealfa beta deatvavn zeiran. atvavn ravrevan, innun bealma deate. veatvavn zeiran, innun bealma tattaa. 10 zeera, berit kayyayma kaddisha. kevan dekanne pinchas al berit da, ittosaf beh 10 zeera, raza divrit da.

Behahu shaata, amar kudesha berich hu, ma abid im moshe, berit da mimmoshe havi, vechalla dileh havi. genay hu lemehav leh leachara, bela data ureuta demoshe, lav yaut hu. share kudesha berich hu veamar lemoshe, moshe, pinchas ben elazar ben aharon hakkohen. amar leh moshe, ribbono shel olam mahu. amar leh, ant hu demasrat nafshach al yisrael dela yishtetzun min alma bechamma zimnin, veihu heshiv et chamati meal bene yisrael vegomer. amar moshe ma at bae minni, ha kolla didach.

Amar leh, ha kolla didach hi, ema leh detishre begavih. amar moshe, ha belibba shelim tehe legabbeh. amar leh ema ant befumach, vearim kalach, deant masar leh biruta, belibba shelim. hada hu dichtiv, lachen emor, at ema biruta, hinni noten lo et beriti shalom. moshe hava amar hinni noten lo vegomer, deillu kudesha berich hu, hava leh lememar lachen emor lo hinni noten lo et beriti shalom, aval la ketiv ella lachen emor. vei tema, deitabberat min moshe. la. ella kevutzina da deadliku minah, da yahiv veahane, veda la itgara minnah.

Ata hahu tula, veyativ, venashik leh. shamu chad kala dehava amar, penun atar, penun atar leribbi pinchas ben yair, deihu gabbayychu. detanenan, dechol atar detzaddika itchaddash beh mille deorayyta, kad ihu behahu alma, pakid lehahu atar, veate leh legabbeh. vekol shekken kad sharan begavvivy tzaddikayyay acharanin. lechadta behahu atar, deamrin mille deorayyta. kegavvna da dehava ate ribbi pinchas ben yair lemifkkad leatreh, veashkach illen tzaddikayyay mechadtin millin deorayyta, veitchaddash kemillekaddemin, hahu milla deribbi pinchas ben yair kammeh.

Amar ribbi abba, yaut milla deribbi pinchas ben yair, deha la ketiv lachen hinni noten, ella lachen emor hinni noten lo. vechi milla da hava geniza mechasida da techot yedach, vela havit amar. zakkaa chulakana, dezachena lemehevi besiyyata detula kaddisha hacha.

Uf hu patach veamar, mishshemeh doribbi pinchas (Kohelet 9:10) kol asher timtza yadcha laasot bechochacha ase vegomer, kama yaut leh lebar nash beod devutzina dalik vesharya al resheh, leishtaddela ulemebad reuta demareh. begin dehahu nehora devutzina, ihi koach desharya aleh. veal da ketiv, (Bamidbar 14:17) yigdal na koach Adonai. koach Adonai, da hu koach, desharya al reshehon detzaddikayyay, vechol innun demishtaddelin biruta demarehon. veal da tanenan, kol haone amen yehe shemeh rabba mevarach bechol kocho. (da ihu kocho)
Vday itzterich leitteara kol shayyfoy bechela takkif begin divittearuta takkif deittakaf, ittear hahu koach kaddisha illaa, veistallak go kudesha veittebar chela vetukepa desitra achara. veal da
1471: Ki en maase vecheshbon vegomer, begin divhahu koach it maase, ishtaddeluta leishtaddela behay alma deikre maase, alma deovada, lemishlam sofa demachashava. vecheshbon, da hu alma, detalya bedibbura, deha cheshbon bedibbura talyay. veal da, kol gimatriyyot, utekufin, veibburin dealma, besihara havo. vedaat, da ihu raza deshit sitrin, detalyayn bemachashava, veikrun alma dehahu machashava. vechachma, decholla talyay minneh.

Vechol illen kelilan behahu koach, ma delav hachi besitra dishol, darga degehinnam. deha kol bar nash dela ishtaddal behay koach, behay alma, lealaa beh, bemaase vecheshbon vadaat vechachma, sofeh lealaa bashsheol, delet beh maase vecheshbon vedaat vechachma. deha sitra ochora, orach sheol ihi, dichtiv, (Mishlei 7:27) darche sheol betah. man deitrappe mehay koach kaddisha, attekaf beh sitra achara, dishol betah.

Asher atta holech shamma, vechi kol bene alma azle lishol. in. aval sallekin miyyad, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 2:6) morid sheol vayyaal. bar innun chayyayvin, dela hirheru teshuva lealmin, denachtin vela sallekin. vaafillu tzaddikim gemurim nachtin tamman. amay nachtin. begin denatlin kama chayyayvin mittamman, vesallekin lon leella. (vetamman avdin lon lehareher bitshuva) uman innun. innun dehirheru bitshuva behay alma, vela yachilu, veistellaku min alma. vetzaddikayyay nachtin beginehon dechayyayvin go sheol, venatlin lon, vesallekin lon min tamman.

Amar ribbi yose, ketiv (Kohelet 7:27) achat leachat limtzo cheshbon. cheshbon degimatriyot dekayyman besihara, bean darga dilah innun. la ativ leh. amar, shemana, vela idkarna milla. kam hahu tula, uvatash beenoy doribbi abba, nafal al anpoy miggo dechilu. ad dehava nafal al anpoy, nafal kera befumeh, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:Adonai) enayich berechot becheshbon al shaar bat rabbim. veillen ayynin dilah, parperaot lego chachma illaa, deitmashshecha milleella, umiggo cheshbon utekufin veibburin itmalleyayn, veitavidu berechot, denafku miyyamin, lechol sitrin, (nusach acher inun ayynin) ad deitpakdan lechol chusheban veibburin desihara bilvad (sefer acher dilvar), vechochavin umazzale lemebad cheshbon, veda ihu al shaar bat rabbim, da ihi sihara dilvar.

Amar ribbi abba leribbi yose, hahu margela kaddisha dehava techot yedach, miggo siyyata dachasida kaddisha deihu gabban, kamma shappir ihu, veahadarna beh. deha vadday la itzterich leappaka itteta, lemishre baatar achara, ad devalah yafked lah veyahiv lah reshu lemehach. veodin levalah bekadmita, umefayysin leh, dehu yafked lah, veyahiv lah reshu lemehach lehahu atar. kach kudesha berich hu payis lemoshe, vead deyahav leh reshu, veamar leh ema ant, hinni noten lo et beriti shalom, lemishre begavvivy, vead deyahav lah reshu lemehach tamman, la azlat.

Menalan. mitztzaddiko shel olam, deyahiv lah reshu, lemishre go tzaddike behay alma. veyatva immehon, kechalla go kishshutaha. vetzaddika dealma chame, vechadde behay. aval ben deroe devalah shechivat, veithadderat lemehevi bahadayyhu, vetavat levalah. kema deat amer, (Ester 2:14) baerev hi vaa uvabboker hi shava. baerev hi vaa, legabbe balah. uvabboker hi shava, legabbe tzaddikayyay dealma. vecholla birshuta devalah. (hada hu dichtiv, 1 vetzaddik chonen venoten).

Umoshe kach amar, hinni noten lo et beriti, kema detzaddik dilella noten, uf ana hinni noten, mattana lemehadar mattana ihi. uvegin berit da, ravavch kehuna illaa. vei la tehe bahadeh, la itkeshar pinchas bedarga dichhuna illaa, deha berit davka ihu tadir bimina illaa. vimina illaa da, zammin lemivne be makdesha, deihu berit.
Amar ribbi abba, idkarna milla chada, deshamana mibbutzina kaddisha, deshama mishshemeh deribbi eliezer. yoma chad, ata lekammeh chad chakkim goy, amar leh sava sava, telat bayayn
1472: Baena lemitba minach. chad, deattun amrin deyitbene lechu be makdesha ochora, veha la havo lemivne ella tere zimnin, bayit rishon uvayit sheni, bayit shelishi (uvet revii) la tishkach beorayyta, veha ma dehava leh lemivne, kevar itbanun, uleolam let beh yattir, deha tere batte yisrael kara lon kera. uchetiv, (Chagai 2:9) gadol yihye kevod habbayit hazze haacharon min harishon.

Vetu, deattun amrin, deattun kerevin lemalka illaa, yattir mikkol shear ammin, man demitkeriv lemalka, ihu chadde (yattir) tadir, bela tzaara, bela dechilu, uvela dechiku. veha attun betzaara uvedochaka uvigona tadir, yattir mikkol bene alma. vaanan la itkeriv lan tzaara vedochaka vigona kelal. anan kerivin lemalka illaa, veattun rechikin minneh, veal da it lechu tzaara vedochaka evla vigona, ma dela it lan.

Vetu, deattun la achle nevela uterefa, begin dittehevon beriin, vegufa dilchon lihevi bivriuta. anan achlenan kol ma devaenan, vaanan takkifin bechela bivriuta, vechol shayyfon dilan bekiyyumayyhu. veattun dela achlin, challashin kulchu bemarin bishin, uvitviru yattir mikkol shear ammin. amma desane lechon elahachon becholla. sava sava, la tema li middi, dela ashmeinach, vela akabbel minach. zakif enoy ribbi eliezer, veashgach beh, veitavid tilla degarme.

Kevan denach rugezeh, ahdar resheh uvacha, veamar, (Tehillim 8:2) Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha bechol haaretz. kama takkif chela dishma kaddisha, takkifa bechol ara, vechamma chavivin mille deorayyta, delet lach milla zeera dela tishkach lah beorayyta, velet milla zeera deatya beorayyta, dela nafkat mippumeh dekudesha berich hu. millin illen deshaal hahu rasha, ana shaalna yoma chad leeliyyahu, veamar deha bimtivta dirkia, itsedaru kammeh dekudesha berich hu, vehachi hu.

Dechad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, baa kudesha berich hu lemebad lon beara, kemalachin kaddishin leella, uvaa lemivne lon beta kaddisha, ulenachta leh miggo sheme rekiin, ulenattea lon leyisrael, netziva kaddisha, kegavvna dediyyukena dilella. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:17) teviemo vetittaemo behar nachalatcha. bean atar bemachon leshivtecha paalta Adonai. behahu defaalta ant Adonai, vela achara. machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai, da bayit rishon. mikkedash Adonai konnu yadecha, da bayit sheni. vetarvavyyhu, umanuta dekudesha berich hu innun.

Umiddeargizu kammeh bemadbera, mitu, veachnas lon kudesha berich hu livnayyhu beara. (avelaypav ovadehon) uveta itbene al yeda devar nash, uvegin kach la itkeyyaym. ushelomo hava yada, divgin dehay ovada devar nash la yitkayyaym, veal da amar, (Tehillim 127:1) im Adonai lo yivne vayit shav amlu vonav bo, deha let leh beh kiuma. beyomoy deezra, garam chattaa, veitztarchun innun lemivne, vela hava beh kiuma. vead kean, binyayna kadmaa dekudesha berich hu, la hava bealma, ulezimna deate ketiv, (Tehillim 147:2) bone yerushala 40 Adonai, ihu vela ochora. uvinyayna da anan mechakkan, vela binyayna devar nash, delet beh kiyyuma kelal.

Bayit rishon, uvayit sheni, yachit lon kudesha berich hu kachada milleella. bayit rishon beitkasya, uvayit sheni beitgalya. hahu bayit lehevi beitgalya, deitkere bayit sheni, deyitchaze lechol alma umanuta dekudesha berich hu. chedva shelim, ureuta delibba bechol kiyyuma.

Hahu bayit rishon beitkasya, istellak leella, al gabboy dehahu deitgalya. vechol alma yechomun, anane yekar desacharan al gabbe dehahu deitgalyay, uvego deinnun ananin, havi bayit rishon, beovada temira, desalik ad rum yekar shemayyay, uvinyayna da anan mechakkan.

Vead kean, la hava bealma, deafillu karta diyrushalam la lihevi umanuta debar nash, deha ketiv, (Zecharya 2:9) vani ehye lah neum Adonai chomat esh saviv vegomer. i lekarta ketiv hachi, kol shekken beta, deihu diyyura dileh. veovada da, havi itchaze lemehevi beresha, kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, veistellak ad lesof yomin, befurekana
1473: Sheelta achara, devday anan kerevin lemalka illaa, yattir mikkol shear ammin. vday hachi hu, deyisrael avad lon kudesha berich hu libba dechol alma. vehachi innun yisrael ben shear ammin, kelibba ben shayyfin, kema deshayyfin la yachle lemekam bealma afillu riga chada bela libba, hachi ammin kullehu, la yachlin lemekam bealma, bela yisrael. veof hachi yerushalam bego shear aran, kelibba bego shayyfin. veal da ihi beemtzaita dechule alma. kelibba go shayyfin.

Veyisrael mitnahagan go shear ammin, kegavvna delibba go shayyfin. libba ihi rachich vechalash, veihu kiyyuma dechol shayyfin, la yada mitztzaara veaka vigona kelal ella libba, deveh kiuma, deveh sucheltanu, shear shayyfin la itkeriv behu kelal, deha let behu kiyyuma, vela yadin midi. kol shear shayyfin la kerivin lemalka, deihu chachmeta vesucheltanu, desharya bemocha, ella libba. ushear shayyfin, rechikin minneh, vela yadin minneh kelal. kach yisrael, lemalka kaddisha kerivin, ushear ammin rechikin minneh.

Sheelta achara, deyisrael la achle nevelot uterefot, vetinnufa velichlucha dishkatzim uremasim kishar ammin, hachi hu, deha libba deihu rachich vechalash, umalka vekiyyuma dechol shear shayyfin, la natil limzoneh, ella beriru vetzachuta dechol dama, umezoneh naki uverira, veihu rachich vechalish mikkolla, ushear pesolet anach lechol shayyfin, vechol shear shayyfin la mashgichin behay, ella kol pesolet uvish decholla natlin, veinnun bitkifu kema deitchaze lon.

Veal da bechol shear shayyfin it avabuin, seet o sappachat, segiru detzaraat. lelibba, lav mikkol hane kelum, ella ihu naki berira mikkolla, let beh muma kelal. kach kudesha berich hu natil leh leyisrael deihu naki uveriru delet beh muma al da ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:7) kullach yafa rayati umum en vach. ata ribbi yose, nashik yedoy, amar, illu la atena lealma, ella lemishma da, dayyi.

(Bamidbar 22) veshem ish yisrael hammukke vegomer. amar ribbi yitzchak, hay kera hachi hava leh lemichtav, veshem ish yisrael asher hikka pinchas, velo hammukke asher hukka, la neemar ella beorach satim.

Ella hachi amar ribbi elazar (nusach acher 0 rabbi shimon), kevan desalkeh kudesha berich hu lefinchas lechahana rabba, la baa leadkera leh lefinchas bekatlanuta devar nash. deha la itchaze lechahana rabba. ad la salkeh lechahana rabba, adkar leh, veamar vayyar pinchas vayyikkach romach vegomer, vayyidkor et shenehem vegomer. kevan desalkeh lechahana rabba la adkar shemeh bekatlanuta, dela itchaze leh, vechas aleh yekara dekudesha berich hu, dechahana rabba la itchaze leadkera bekatlanuta. veshem haishsha hammukka, uf hachi.

Ribbi shimon hava azil mikkapputekiyya lelud, vribbi yehuda azil immeh, ad dahavo azle paga behu ribbi pinchas ben yair, uteren guverin toanin avatreh. shachich chamareh deribbi pinchas. tainu leh, vela azil. amar ribbi pinchas, sheviku leh, deha recha deanpin chadtin ka arach, o nissa itavid lan hasheta. ad deinnun tamman, nafak ribbi shimon mibbatar chad tinara. natal chamara veazil, amar ribbi pinchas, vela amarit lechu, deha recha deanpin chadtin ka arach.

Nachat vegafif leh ribbi pinchas, uvacha, amar leh, chamena bechelmi, deatya shechinta legabbi, veyahavat li nevizbezan ravrevan, vechaddina bah. hasheta kema dachamena. amar ribbi shimon, mikkal parse dachamarach, yedana deant hu. hasheta chedva shelim. amar ribbi pinchas, netiv beduch chad, demille deorayyta itzterich tzachuta. ashkachu ena demayay, veilana, yatvu.

Amar ribbi pinchas, mistakkal havina deha litchiyyayt hammetim, bearcha ochora yabid lon kudesha berich hu, uma dehava hasheta kadmaa, lihevi keden batraa. menalan. meinnun atzamot, hanehu garmin deachaya lon kudesha berich hu al yede yechezkel, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 37:7) vattikrevu atzamot etzem el atzmo bekadmita, ulevatar ketiv
1474: Veraiti vehinne alehem gidim uvasar ala vegomer. vayyikram alehem or milmala veruach en bahem. deha ma deafshit bekadmita, liheve batraa. bekadmita (apeshayt merucha, ulevatar) or, ulevatar basar, bekadmita afshit merucha, ulevatar or, ulevatar basar, ulevatar atzamot.

Amar rabbi shimon, beda akshan kadmae, aval garmin illen deachaya kudesha berich hu, nissin veatin meshanyayn, avad behu kudesha berich hu. ta chaze ma ketiv, (Iyov 10:9) zechar na ki chachomer asitani veel afar teshiveni. ma ketiv batreh, halo chechalav tatticheni vechaggevina takpieni, or uvasar talbisheni uvaatzamot vegidim tesochcheni. zammin kudesha berich hu, levatar deyitbele bar nash beafra, umate zimna ditchiyayt hammetim, dehahu garma deyishtear. lemebad leh keisa da, vechaggevina dechalav, unevia kechalav, dehu neviu naki metzuchetzach betzachuta hahu garma. kad yitarav hahu garma veyitmeche kechalava, ulevatar yakpi leh, veyittzayyer betziyyura kaggevina bikpiuta, ulevatar yitmeshach aleh or uvasar vaatzamot vegidim.

Hada hu dichtiv halo chechalav tatticheni vechaggevina takpieni. hittachtani la ketiv, ella tatticheni. hikpitani la ketiv, ella takpieni. hilbashtani la ketiv, ella talbisheni. sochachtani la ketiv, ella tesochcheni. kullehu levatar zimna mashma.

Ulevatar ma ketiv, chayim vachesed asita immadi, da rucha dechayye. (sefer acher vei tema) asita immadi ketiv, vela ketiv taase. ella hachi amar, chayim vachesed asita immadi. behahu alma shadit bi rucha dechayyim, aval ufekuddatcha, dematronita demalka, shamra ruchi, ihi natrat leruchi, behahu alma. may ufekuddatcha, deat zammin lefakda lah bekadmita.

(Shamra ruchi) veraza demilla da, kol nafshin detzadikayyay, genizin utemirin techot kurseyay demalka, veihi natra lon, leatava lon leduchetayyhu, hada hu dichtiv ufekuddatcha shamra ruchi. may ufekuddatcha. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 109:8) pekuddato yikkach acher. pekuddatcha, da matronita demalka, dechol ruchin innun pikdonin bidaha, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 31:6) beyadcha afkid ruchi vegomer, veihi natra lon, begin da shamra ruchi, veihi natrat lah.

Kegavvna da amar david, (Tehillim 86:2) shamra nafshi ki chasid ani. shamra: da matronita demalka. deihi natra nafshi, begin ki chasid ani. uvechol atar dichtiv setam, da matronita. kema deat amer, (Shemot 24:16) vayyikra el moshe. (Shemot 15:26) vayyomer im shamoa tishma bekol Adonai elohecha.

Bacha ribbi pinchas, veamar, velav amarit lach dishchinta yahavat li nevizbezan umatnan, zakkaa chulaki dezachena lemechome lach, veshamana da. amar leh, behahu zimna, tinach hahu garma, shear garmin deyishtachchun ma yitavid minnehon. amar leh, kullehu yitkelilu behahu neviu dehay garma, veyitkelilu bahadeh, veyitavid kolla issa chada, vetamman yittzayyer tziyyura, kema deittemar. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:11) veatzmotecha yachalitz. may yachalitz. kema deat amer (Hoshea Adonai:6) chalatz mehem. kullehu yitabberun mikkiumayyhu, veyitkelilu behay garma, lemehevi issa chada. ucheden (Yeshayahu 58:11) vehayita kegan rav uchemotza mayim vegomer. (amar raya mehemana)

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemana, vavy lon livne nasha, deinnun atimin libba, setimin ayynin, dela yadin dechad ate lelya, tarin degehinnam itfetachu, deihi mara. vashanin dilah demitpashshetin, sallekin ad mocha. vechamma chayyaylin deyetzer hara, mitpashshetin bechol evarin degufa. vetarin degan eden, deihu ayynin delibba, mistatmin vela mitpattechin. dechol nehorin deayynin, millibba nafkin.

Vetarin delibba, innun ayynin mistatmin, begin dela mistakkelin beillen mazzikin, deinnun lilit. vela shaltin binhorin delibba, deinnun malachim demitpashshetin bechol evarim, keanfin deilana lechol sitra. behahu zimna innun kullehu nehorin setimin belibba, umitkanshin legabbeh, (yeshaya 61) keyonim el arubbotehem. kenoach veitteteh, vechol min umin, dealu immeh batteva.

Umazzikin demitgabberin al kol evarim degufa, keme tofana degavru aleh 15 ama, begin dechav beyah, veistallak yah min gufa, veishtear illem, bela reiya ushemia verecha vedibbur. veraza demilla, (Tehillim 39:3) neelamti dumiyya (hechesheti mittov ucheevi nekar), dumiyya: dom yah. kehahu zimna, chamesh esre amma, gavru mazzikin al gufa. veinnun kechisla leugeya.
1475: Uchegavvna denoach, shalach et hayyona bishlichuteh. uf hachi shalach nishmeta baadam. rucheh bishlichuteh. uvegin da tzarich bar nash lefakda lah bematronita. hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 31:6) beyadcha afkid ruchi. veim hi asira bechovoy degufa, bida dechayyaylin deyetzer hara, ma ketiv, beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet.

Veod bezimna deihi chayyevet, ma ketiv berucheh, (Mishlei 11:21) yad leyad lo yinnake ra. deazil miyyad leyad, bemashiryayn deyetzer hara, desharyayn aleh bechovin dileh, vezarkin leh meatar laatar. vehay ihu deachze garmeh bimdina acheret, o bemalchu achara, ulezimnin baashpa, kefum chovoy. vei ihu zakkaa, kol mashiryayn deyetzer tov kullehu, (Yechezkel 1:8) ufenehem vechanfehem perudot, lekabbelah rucheh, vesallekin leh leella, laatar dechevan dechurseyay, vetamman chaze, kama chezyonot, dimyonot, umarot dinvua. uvegin da okmuha rabbanan, dechalom echad mishshishim bannevua. veod (Tehillim 86:2) shamra nafshi ki chasid ani, af al gav doukemuah baggemara vela chasid ani shekkol malche mizrach umaarav yeshenim ad 4 shaot vaani (Tehillim 119:62) chatzot layla akum lehodot lach. velo od ella shekkol malche mizrach umaarav vechulei vaani yaday meluchelachot bedam shappir veshilya kede letaher ishsha levalah. miyad izdaman leh tzefardea veamar leh lamma at meshabbachat garmach lememar chatzot layla akum lehodot lach vaana kol lelya la shachivna leshabbecha leh ulenagna kammeh. amar david vavy lemmana dehahu tzefardea dela yada may deana amena dela amena ki chasid ani.

Ella begin deokmuha rabbanan. velo am haaretz chasid. deorayyta ityehivat mimina dekudesha berich hu, deihu chesed. uvegin da, man deitassek beorayyta, itkere chasid. begin da, amena lekudesha berich hu, shamra nafshi, vela tidun lah keovade illen amme haaratzot, deittemar behu velo am haaretz chasid. vei tema, kamma amme haaratzot innun deavdu chesed. ella hachi ukemuha, e zehu chasid, ze hammitchassed im kono. kegon david dehava mechabber. umay hava mechabber, orayyta dilella hava mechabber im kudesha berich hu. uvegin da, shamra nafshi ki chasid ani.

Vechad bar nash mit, ma ketiv bah behay nefesh (Mishlei 6:22) behithallechcha tanche otach beshachbecha tishmor alecha, vahakitzota litchiyyayt hammetim, hi tesichecha. da litchiyyayt hammetim shappir, deyokim leh lebar nash, aval leagra lenishmeta bealma deate, may havi.

Ella kudesha berich hu malbish lah kekadmeta baanane kavod. kekadmeta teul bemara, deihu kegavvna degufa, kalil bermch evarim. uf hachi teul bamara, kalil bematayim vearbaim ushemona fikkudin uvermch. nehirin demitparshan mehahu mara. deittemar beh, (Bamidbar 12:6) vayyomer im yihye neviachem Adonai bamara elav etvda. uvilvushin daanane kavod (Bereshit 9:16) ureitiha lizkor berit olam, da aspaklaryaa hammeira. (Bamidbar 12:6) bachalom adabber bo, da aspaklaryaa dela nahara. kalil mishs nehirin, kechushban yeshena. vehayeynu (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) ani yeshena. chad bealma den. vechad bealma deate. veinnun beovde yedoy dekudesha berich hu.

Veraza dilhon, (Shemot 3:15) ze shemi leolam. yah im shemi, shalosh meot vachamishsha veshishim. 11 im zichri, mattayim ushemona vearbaim. vecharozin nachtin vesallekin kammeh, havu yekar (sefer acher lediyyukena) likara demalka.

Vehayeynu (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo betzelem elohim bara oto. vehu deavad leh bitren diukenin, bitren gannim (nusach acher panim) deittemar alayyhu (Shir HaShirim 5) hayyoshevet baggannim ihu illat al kolla deittemar alah (Devarim 4:15) ki lo reitem kol temuna. veal shear diukenin ketiv, temunat kol vegomer. (Bamidbar 12:8) utemunat Adonai yabbit. vetryg malachin sallekin lah lenishmeta. beillen diukenin, kullehu ufenehem vechanfehem perudot, lekayyem kera dichtiv behon (Shemot 19:4) vaessa etchem al kanfe nesharim vaavi etchem elay.

Kegavvna denafku mimmitzrayim, veazlu baanane kavod, uvechol hahu yekar, kehahu gavvna tehe mafkanuta denishmeta, migufa detippa serucha, lemezal litren gannim, deitbere shemaya veara dilhon beshem Adonai. uvegineh ittemar, (Tehillim 96:11) yismechu hashshamayim vetagel haaretz. behahu zimna yitkayyem bebar nash (Yeshayahu 30:20) velo yikkanef od morecha legabbaych, (Yeshayahu 6:2) bishtayim yechasse panav, ella vehayu enecha root et morecha. umissitra deillen marot, zacha moshe rabbenu alav hashalom, rabban shel neviim vachachamim. amar butzina kadisha, ant hu dezachit bechayaych, lema deyizkun tzadikayya batar chayyehon, zakkaa chulakach.
Davar acher shamra nafshi ki chasid ani, amay. kede sheetchassed im ani. deittemar beh ani vahu. vavy leh leman deafrish
1476: Ani min hu. deittemar (Tehillim 100:3) hu asanu velo anachnu. decholla chad bela piruda. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:39) reu atta ki ani ani hu ani amit vaachayye machatzti vaani erpa veen miyyadi matztzil. ani Adonai, ani hu velo acher. veda ani min adonay. yedod ammuda deemtzaita.

Uvegin deydod ihu limina deihi chesed, amar, shamra nafshi deetchassed bach im ani, veihu adonay laggevura. uvetiferet, itchabberan teren shemahan 91. veraza demilla bechesed uvigvura, (Yechezkel 1:11) ufenehem vechanfehem perudot milmala uvetiferet, deitkere (Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama, ma ketiv (Yechezkel 1:11) shetayim chovrot ish, tarten shemahan mitchabberan beh kachada. ushetayim mechassot et geviyyotehena. tiferet itkere guf, (Daniel 10:6) ugeviyyato chatarshish 47.

(Tehillim 86:2) hosha avdecha atta elohay sammeach nefesh avdecha tena uzzecha leavdecha. telat zimnin itavid david eved bithilla da, lokovel 3 zimnin, deokmuha mare matnitin, devae bar nash lemehevi avda bitzlota. bevirchan kadmain, keeved dimsadder shevachoy kamme rabbeh. beemtzaiyyot, keavda devae peras merabbeh. baacharonot, keeved demode kodam rabbeh, bapperas dekabbil mineh, veazil leh.

Utelat zimnin devae lemebad eved, missitra deavoda. deokmuha mare matnitin, delet avoda ella tefilla. utelat avahan, itkeriu avadim missitraha, al shem shechinta, deihi avodat Adonai. veof hachi moshe eved Adonai. uvegin da, (Vayikra 25) ki li bene yisrael avadim. aval legabbe acharanin, kol yisrael bene melachim hem, missitra demalchut. veihi amay itkeriat avoda. keorach deitteta lemiflach levalah, veorach benin, lemiflach laavuhon.

Vedavid, itavid ani, chasid, veeved. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 86:1-2) tefilla ledavid hatte adonay aznecha aneni ki ani veevyon ani. shamra nafshi ki chasid ani. hosha avdecha atta elohay habboteach elecha. itavid ani letara demalka, deittemar bah, (Tehillim 51:17) adonay sefatay tiftach. adonay hechal, itavid ani letara dehechala demalka. uma ketiv. hatte adonay aznecha aneni veda shechinta tattaa. deihu ozen lekabbela tzelotin ulemishma lon. kedichtiv, (Tehillim 22:25) ki lo vaza velo shikkatz enut ani velo histir panav mimmennu uveshavveo elav shamea.

Deihu itavid ani vedal, missitra deat 4 min echad, lemishal min 9, deihu ammuda deemtzaita. lekayyeyma beh, (Tehillim 116:6) dalloti veli yehoshia, dela yemut mashiach ben efrayim. veshail minneh behahu tara, begin yisrael haaniyim, lekayyem behu (Shmuel 2 22:28) veet am ani toshia.

Ulevatar shail begin kahanayay, deyachazor avoda limkomah, veitavid eved. ulevatar deyahiv lon orayyta missitra dechesed, lemebad gemul im dalet min orayyta, uvegin da itavid chasid. kach mata leg sefiran illain, patach veamar (Tehillim 131:1) Adonai lo gava libbi velo ramu enay velo hillachti bigdolot uveniflaot mimmenni.

Shelomo amar, ha bina ihi demoshe, eshal bechachma illaa, deihi leel middargeh. ma ketiv, (Kohelet 7:23) amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni. veha ketiv (Melachim 1 Adonai:26) vaAdonai natan chachma lishlomo. chachma zeera. uvaa lesalleka mittatta leella, deitrechikat minneh. begin deafillu labbina let bar nash bealma deyachil lesalleka, bar mimmoshe, kol shekken leella minneh, deihu chachma illaa, missitra dilah chacham adif minnavi. veaf al gav deukemuha beorach derasha, al para aduma. shivim panim lattora.

Ribbi elazar, kum lechaddesha millin kamme shechinta, di tehe ezer leavicha, dishma garim, ezer el, el mimina, ezer missemala. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:18) eese lo ezer kenegdo. bemay. bezera shappir, deihu hefech ezer. veyekum ribbi yose immach, deihu kurseyay shelemata lemareh, dehachi salik yose, lecheshbon hakkisse, elohim bechusheban.

Veyekum immeh ribbi yehuda, deveh hod, uveh yah, uveh yedod 4, 4 chevan. (Yechezkel 1:8) ufenehem vechanfehem perudot, kullehu, lekabbela leh. uminneh david, dehoda lekudesha berich hu, darga behodaot deihu mitztzad hod. veyekum immeh ribbi elay, begimatriya yabbok, baki behilcheta.

Veyekum immeh ribbi yuday, dechushebaneh el. kegon michael, malachin reshimin beel. kegon (Bereshit 31:29) yesh leel yadi. veraza deel, 1 demut adam. 30 telat chevan, deinnun 4 anfin lechol chad, dirmizin (sefer acher bah) baAdonai bechushevan 30 telat yodin, (nusach acher olim 30). veinnun berashe telat azkarot, deinnun Adonai melech, Adonai malach, Adonai yimloch leolam vaed. veyekum ribbi abba immehon, deihu chushebaneh 4, 4 chevan.
1477: Ribbi shimon ihu keilana, veribbi elazar bereh vechavroy, deinnun chamishsha deadkarna, kaanafin deilana ravrevin dedamyayn lidroin veshokin.

Kum rabbi shimon, veyitchaddeshun millin mippumach, behay kera demillekaddemin. lamnatztzeach, tamman netzach, nigun tzach. uveh itkere yedod mare natzchan keravin, legabbe umin ovde kochavim umazzalot dealma, verachamin vedina leyisrael. veraza demilla, (Mishlei 11:10) uvaavod reshaim rinna. 70, shivin shemahan it leh, veim netzach vehod, amud bet, kechusheban chesed, veraza demilla, (Tehillim 16:11) neimot bimincha netzach.

Hod, beh (divrei hayamim 1 16:8) hodu laAdonai. tzaddik, beh (Tehillim 33:2) rannenu tzaddikim baydod. uveh (Yirmeyahu 31:7) rannu leyaakov simcha. tiferet, beh halelu el. haleluyah, halelu yah. detamman Adonai. benigun uvezemer, chesed ugevura. beshir uvivracha, chachma uvina. beashre, keter. bithilla, malchut.

Mizmor, beh raz, uveh mum. missitra dezemer deorayyta vezemer ditzlota. zemer missitra achara, ihi mum zar. zimra beveta, charba beveta. nidda shifcha bat ovde kochavim umazzalot zona. veda atvavn mizmor. niggun, tamman gan. hachi shepiru deniguna, beh hallel. kegon (Shemot 12:42) lel shimmurim hu laAdonai lehotziam meeretz mitzrayim. ashre deveh share alma meshabbechin, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo. bivracha, (Tehillim 34:2) avarcha et Adonai bechol et. battehilla, tamid tehillato befi.

(Tehillim 60:1) al shushan edut, da hod. deihu shushan, sumak shallit al chivvavr, denetzach shallit ihu chivvavr al sumak. may edut. da tzaddik. ihu berit, deihu achid lishmayya veara. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 4:26) haidoti vachem hayyom et hashshamayim veet haaretz. may michtam. mach tam mach, ihu tzaddik. tam, ammuda deemtzaita, darga deyaakov. ish tam. guf uverit chashvenan chad. lelammed, chesed ugevura, demittamman orayyta ityehivat, lilmod ulelammed.

Amar leh shappir kaamart, aval (Tehillim 12:1) lamnatztzeach al hashsheminit, dela tazuz netzach min hod, deihi sefira 8, amar lamnatztzeach al hashsheminit. amar butzina kaddisha, i hachi, bina darga dilach, vaamay okmuha venittan hahod lemoshe, shenneemar (Bamidbar 27:20) venatatta mehodcha alav.

Amar leh, shappir ka shaalta. Adonai salleka beat 10, chamesh zimnin eser, lechamshin tarin devina, veitpashshetuta dilhon mechesed ad hod, hen chamesh asra bechol sefira, innun chamshin. uvegin da, mibbina ad hod, kolla itpashshetuta chada. levatar ata tzaddik, venatil kol chamshin tarin bilchodoy, lemehevi shakil lechol chamesh, veitkere kol, denatil kol chamshin tarin. veof hachi kalla, nettilat lehu kullehu. amar, kean vadday ityayshav milla al bureyeh.

Veod lamnatztzeach, tamman 70 im netzach. veda 70 min chashmal. min 308, hod venetzach, innun lokovel teren sifvavn. uvegin da itkeriu sifvavn, chevan eshsha memallela. uvachagiga ad hechan maase merkava, veokmuha min vaere ad chashmal. demistera digvura itkeriu chevan eshsha. venahar denafik mizzean dilhon, yesod. kullehu telat innun merkava letiferet, adam.
Maase merkava, da malchut. uvitlat illen, ihu chachma uvina vadaat. uvegin da ukemuha mare matnitin, deen dorshin bemaase merkava beyachid, ella im ken hu chacham umevin middato.

Veit merkava letatta mizzeer anpin, deihu metatron. adam hakkatan. devammerkava dileh deihu pardes, redife mayya deorayyta, denafik miggo pardes dileh, litlat mearba, deittemar alayyhu, arbaa nichnesu lappardes. veha ittemar.

Deihu tzippara dechaza rabba bar bar channa, lechef yamma deorayyta, deyamma mate ad korsuloy. veresheh mate ad tzet shemaya, vela achshilu telat beh, mishshum dinfishe mayya dileh, ella mishshum dirdife mayya veokmuha.
Abeg kalil lon desallekin leshit, lokovel atvavn metatron. reviaa 4, (Melachim 1 19:12) kol demama dakka, detamman ate malka. veihu adam lashevet al hakkisse.

21, Mayim elyonim, umayim tachtonim. delet benayyhu ella kimlo nima, deihu 6, natuy benayyhu, barakia deihu mavdil ben mayim lamayim, diyhe havedala ben nukeba lidchura. begin da (Bereshit 1:6) vihi mavdil veraza demilla, yeahdonahi. mayim elyonim zecharim 10 illaa, mayim tachtonim nekevot, 10 tattaa. shit atvavn benayyhu, kechusheban 6, da metatron, deihu ben 1.

Veod, yod nekuda. 6 galgal. velet tenua begalgal beshit sitrin kechusheban 6, ella behahi nekuda. vehahu nekuda ihu yichuda decholla, veashidat al hahu yachid, delet leh sheni, deokmuha aleh rabbanan, shetzarich leyachado kede shettamlichehu al
1478: Hashshamayim veal haaretz, veal 4 ruchot alma. 2, shamayim vaaretz. 3, ammuda savil lon. 4, arba chevan. Adonai kurseyay. 6, shit dargin lechurseyay. veod, 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9: adam. 10 yichud dileh, malchut, ashiraa deadam. tesha, ihu lokovel tesha atvavn. zakkain innun yisrael, deyadin raza demarehon.

Davar acher, tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et karbani lachmi leishshay reach nichochi. ribbi yehuda amar, bekarbana it ashan, veit reach, veit reach nichoach, ashan ihu missitra dedina, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 29:19) ki az yeshan af Adonai. (Tehillim 18:9) ala ashan beappo veesh mippiv tochel. reach nichochi, rachame. (Shir HaShirim 50) vereach appech kattappuchim.

Amar raya mehemana, veha tarvavyyhu ashan vereach, innun beaf, ukerain sahadin. chad, ala ashan beappo. vetinyayna, vereach appech kattappuchim. vaamay itkere chad ashan dina vetinyayna rachame. ella, bechotama it teren challonin, veittemar bismala, ala ashan beappo, may ala. ella milibba deihu bismala, lokovel gibbor. mimina nachit rucha legabbeh, lekarra leh, uleshakkecha rugezeh, missitra dechesed, detamman mocha. chachma limina, harotze lehachekim yadrim. bina belibba, kelappe semala, harotze lehaashir yatzpin. uvegin da ala ashan beappo, min bina legabbe chachma, deihi limina, umekabbel leh bechedva, benigguna delevae.

Vehay ashan la salik, ella al yede esh, deadlik beetzim, deinnun evarim malyayn pikudin, atze ola. mare tora, orayyta deihi adlikat behon, esh betukefa digvura, veala ashan behon. babbina ashan hamaaracha.

Umiddislikat leaf, itkere ketoret, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 33:10) yasimu ketora beappecha. velet devatil motana bealma, kakketoret, deihu kishshura dedina berachame, im reach nichoach beaf. targum dekesher ketiru. amar ribbi yehuda, zakkaa chulakana deravavchna millin setimin beitgalyay. od amar butzina kaddisha, devatar ditzlota ihi kekarbena, man deyemma pittum hakketoret, batar tehilla ledavid, batil motana mibbeta.

Amar raya mehemana, kean bae leminda, ech atkinu tzelotin lokovel karbenin. ella telat tzelotin, lokovel et hakkeves haechad taase vabboker, da tzelota deshachrit, deittemar bah, (Bereshit 19:27) vayyashkem avraham vabboker el hammakom asher amad sham et pene Adonai. veokmuha rabbanan, delet amida ella tzelota. veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim, lekabbel tzelota demincha, detakkin lah yitzchak. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:63) vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade lifnot erev. velet sicha, ella tzelota. tzelota dearvit, lokovel emurin ufedarin demitakkelin kol hallayla. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 28:11) vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham ki va hashshemesh. velet pegia, ella tzelota.

Addehachi daanan baatar da, amay ketiv vayyikkach meavne hammakom vayyasem meraashotav vayyishkav bammakom hahu, vechi la havo leh karim uchesatot lemishkav. ella hoil veata chatan legabbe kalla, af al gav dela hava archoy lemishkav ella bekarim uchesatot, veihi yehivat leh avanim lemishkav, yekabbel kolla biruta delibba, veha ittemar. veof hachi ittemar bechibbura kadmaa. mahu dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:3) vayyomer yaakov kaasher raam, amar rabbi shimon tiv. veema kera, (ad kan raya mehemana) (kakkatuv daf 225 amud bet ella pegia 242 sham)

Amar ribbi pinchas, mistakkal havina, shemira ballev ihu vadday, (dechama belev) (sefer acher velev dugema delev ilaa) veal da shamor ballev, velav baatar achara. zechira bazzachar, bemocha, derachiv veshalit al hallev. velet zechira ella bemocha. veal da zachor lezachar veshamor linkeva. mocha deihu dechura, rachiv veshalit al hallev. lev shallit verachiv al hakkaved. kaved samael venachash da beda, veihu chad. (sefer acher veinnun dechar venukeba)

Raya mehemna amar raya mehemana, let karbenin, ella lerachaka sitrin misavin, ulekarva dargin kaddishin. veittemar bechibbura kadmaa, dilhon, (arkin dechavda, illen ishim vechol inun chayyaylin veittemar) arkin dechavda it minnehon ravrevin, it minnehon ravrevin uzeirin, umitpashtin minnehon lechamma sitrin. veillen natlin evarin veemurin ufedarin demitakkelin kol hallayla, deha karban kolla laAdonai.
Amar butztzina kaddisha, raya mehemana, vahalo amrat leel dekarbenin dekudesha berich hu lav innun ella lekarva 10 baAdonai 6 baAdonai. ella, af al gav
1479: Yoteret hakkaved vechaved. veal da bekorbana, yoteret hakkaved, da nachash. kaved mechla didchura, raza desamael.

Amar rabbi shimon, vadday kach hu, veyaut hu. uverira demilla, veraza vesitrin dekarban, hachi hu. kaved natil bekadmita, hu veyoteret dileh, (sefer acher ulevatar yoteret dileh) samael uvat zugo. (sefer acher ulevatar kol vechulei deinnun chayyaylin) vechol innun arkin dechavda. chayyaylin umashiryayn dilhon. unetilu dilhon, deachlin chalavin shamnino dekarbena. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 29) veet hachelev asher alehem. ucheden kariv kolla legabbe lev.

Velev la natil mikkolla. ella vidduy deitavid beh, vesalik behahu tenana utzelota deitavid aleh dekarbena. lev kariv legabbe mocha, reuta deyichuda dechahana beh, vechedvavta delevae. mocha da, nehora deatya mimmocha illaa. mocha kariv legabbeh tamir mikkolla, dela ityeda kelal. (sefer acher legabbeh, mikkelal dela itpera kelal) vecholla itkeshar da beda. umocha kariv nachat ruach decholla.

Arkin dechavda, illen ishim, vechol innun chayyaylehon. kaved, kema deittemar. yoteret nekeva, nukeba dileh. amay yoteret. dela itchabberat bidchura ella kad asharat lah shaata, levatar deavdat neufaha, veshavka leh. tu, yoteret nekeva, dechad baya leitchabbera bebar nash, itavidat legabbeh shiyyurin, dela itchashshavat kelal. levatar ihi itkarvat zeer zeer legabbeh, ad deitaveda leh chibbura chada. umeillen arkin dechavda, mitpashshetan ochoran zeirin, lechamma zayynin, vecholla natlin emurin ufedarin. vechullehu kelilan bakkaved.

Lev deihu ikkara bikdushsha, natil umakriv lemocha kema deittemar. lev sharya al teren kulleyayn, veinnun teren keruvin. yahavin eta. veinnun rechikin kerivin, yemina usemala. vechullehu natlin veachlin kol chad kaddeka yaut, ad deitkeshar kolla kachada.

Dechol karbanin tzerichin lekarev kammeh, ihu palig lechol mashshiryayn, maachalin dekarbenin, lechol chad kadka chaze leh, lesichliyyim, mezone deorayyta, umishteyay deyina umayya deorayyta. letiviyyim, deinnun shedim deinnun kivne adam, yahiv lon illen maachalin tiviyyim, denachit eshsha dilhon, lemechal lon.

Kema deokmuha rabbanan, i zachu, hava nachit kemo arye deeshsha lemechal karbenin. vei la, hava nachit tamman kemin kalba deeshsha. veof hachi kad mit bar nash, i zache, nachit bidmut arye, lekabbela nafsheh. vei lav bidmut kelev, deamar david aleh, (Tehillim 22:21) hatztzila mecherev nafshi miyyad kelev yechidati.

Uvegin leshezava kudesha berich hu gufehon deyisrael minnehon venafshehon. mane, lekarev karbenin diviran vegufan beatrayyhu, lekayyem (Mishlei 25:21) im raev sonaacha haachilehu lachem veim tzame hashekehu mayim. aval kudesha berich hu, la natil ella reuta delibba, uteviru dileh (deihu yisrael). hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 51:19) zivche elohim ruach nishbara lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze. kegavvna dichle cheres, deittemar behon nishbaru nitharu.

Kahana mocha. levi libba. gufa yisrael. veittemar behon, kohanim baavodatam, ulevviyim beduchanam, veyisrael bemaamadam. vei kaved bae lekarva legabbe delibba, chelbeh deinnun misavin, ihu la natil. ella shamnuno dechelev tahor. kegavvna deit begufa, chelev tahor vechelev tame, dam tzalil bela pesolet, vedam achur bappesolet. vearkin delibba, chayyaylin kaddishin. vearkin dechaved, chayyaylin misavin. uf hachi innun mashiryayn deyetztzer hara, umashiryayn deyitztzer hatov, illen memanan al arkin delibba, veillen memanan al arkin dechavda. uf hachi tere ome, yisrael, veumin dealma ovde kochavim umazzalot.

Amar leh raya mehemana, shappir ka amrat becholla, aval afillu yisrael lav kullehu shavin, deit behon bene malchut, missitra demalchut kaddisha, kelila meeser sefiran, umikkol havavyyayn vechinnuyin. veit minnehon avdin, missitra deeved, deihu (Bereshit 24:2) avdo zekan beto. veit minnehon kiviran, veittemar behon, (Yechezkel 34:31) veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem. veinnun dedamyayn leana, kudesha berich hu mane lekarva beiran beatrayyhu, lechappera alayyhu. veinnun dedamyayn lemalachin, karbenin dilhon innun ovadin tavin, dimmanan alayyhu malachim, dimakrivin lekudesha berich hu beatrayyhu.
